d743ba25.title: Bid Manager
d743ba25.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
   

  

**Your Role**
* End\-to\-End Bid Management: Lead complete bid lifecycle—from team setup, pursuit planning, solution development to final submission.
* Strategy \& Collaboration: Work with cross\-functional teams to define win themes, solution strategy, and value proposition.
* Proposal \& Commercials: Develop high\-quality, persuasive RFP/RFI responses including pricing and commercial models.
* Deal Conversion Ownership: Drive conversion metrics (RFP/RFI success rate, TCV wins) and support large deals/vendor empanelment.
* Stakeholder \& Knowledge Management: Manage client visits, senior stakeholder coordination, and build reusable bid assets/repositories.


**Your Profile**
* Bid Management Expertise: Proven experience handling mid\-to\-large complex bids in presales or equivalent roles.
* Commercial \& Financial Acumen: Strong understanding of pricing models, deal structuring, and financial simulations.
* Stakeholder Influence: Ability to engage senior leadership, clients, and lead cross\-functional teams without authority.
* Project \& Communication Skills: Strong organizational, presentation, and articulation capabilities under tight timelines.
* Digital \& AI Enablement: Experience leveraging AI/GenAI tools to improve bid efficiency and quality.


**What You'll Love About Working Here**
* You can shape your career with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group. You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.
* You will get comprehensive wellness benefits including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top\-ups, elder care, partner coverage or new parent support via flexible work.
* At Capgemini, you can work on cutting\-edge projects in tech and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.


 Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

699fe943.title: IT Solutions Consultant
699fe943.description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our IT Solutions Consultants help both internal and external stakeholders find value in Rippling’s platform and IT Cloud products. Our Solutions Consultants focus on revenue generation, value\-driven presentations, and enabling our prospective customers to realize the value of Rippling. Experience working in a pre\-sales capacity with IT systems (identity, MDM, security, AI etc.) is required.
   

  

 You will join a diverse and exceptional team of Solutions Consulting professionals. Rippling SCs drive value for customers and enable a best\-in\-industry buying experience. Rippling is a place where you will do the best work for your life and have a direct hand in driving sales, product, and GTM strategy \- working with a wide range of stakeholders and strategic customers.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Partner with the Sales team to ensure the success of prospects during their evaluation of Rippling
* Understand a prospect’s technical requirements and convey the business value of Rippling’s IT product suite
* Manage technical demonstrations and POCs for prospects that address their unique business objectives
* Create, present, and maintain technical content such that customers are successful using the IT Cloud
* Become a product expert across the entire Rippling platform and understand the competitor landscape
* Provide customer and your own expert feedback to the Product and Engineering teams
* Work with your SC peers and SC leadership to build a best\-in\-class SC organization


**What You Will Need**
* 4\+ years of experience in a pre\-sales role with experience in Identity \& Access Management, Mobile Device Management, security, and/or other IT tools or equivalent professional experience
* Undergraduate degree and/or equivalent related work experience required
* Exceptional communication, presentation and organizational skills
* Self\-starter with a bias towards action, energized by a fast\-paced environment and excited to build


**Additional Information**
 Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com
   

  

 Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

85ff6785.title: Deal Solution Architect - Telco & Media Industry
85ff6785.description:
Industry Solutions Architect (Horizontal/Telco \& Media Plus)
   

  

 Job Title: Industry Solutions Architect (Horizontal/Telco \& Media Plus)
   

  

 Location: India
   

  

 Role Overview:
   

  

 We are seeking a highly experienced Solutions Architect to support strategic deal pursuits originating from our Industry Business Development team. This role is pivotal in shaping and delivering industry\-specific, cross\-functional solutions that align with client needs and our portfolio of offerings. They will be responsible for crafting compelling, scalable, and technically sound solutions that integrate frontier technologies with traditional enterprise systems and bridge cross\-functional offerings into cohesive, client\-ready solutions. The ideal candidate will be abreast with the latest AI developments and capable of creating innovative, scalable solutions that enable 5G, edge computing, AI\-driven customer experience, and digital content ecosystems.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end solutioning of complex, multi\-disciplinary deals across technology, service lines, and technology practices e.g. Cloud, Data \& AI, Consulting, Finance, App Dev etc.
* Collaborate with business development teams to understand client needs, pain points, and strategic goals.
* Design customized solution architectures that align with client objectives and leverage our full suite of offerings.
* Develop pricing models, delivery frameworks, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Align commercial terms with solution architecture.
* Support contract structuring and negotiation.
* Act as a trusted advisor to internal and external stakeholders during pre\-sales and solutioning phases.
* Support client presentations, workshops, and orals with clear articulation of value propositions.
* Bring deep industry knowledge to inform solution design, including regulatory, operational, and competitive landscapes.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies (AI, GenAI, IoT, cloud, edge, networking, etc.) and their application in industry contexts.
* Identify and integrate industry\-specific partners, accelerators, frameworks, and IP into proposals.
* Ensure solution integrity, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Mitigate delivery risks through robust architecture and governance frameworks.
* Contribute to the development of reusable assets, templates, and playbooks for industry solutioning.
* Architect end\-to\-end IT solutions for Telco and Media clients, aligning with business objectives and digital transformation goals.
* Integrate AI\-driven capabilities (including but not limited to \- predictive analytics, generative AI, intelligent automation) into proposals for enhanced operational efficiency.
* Learn and apply deep knowledge of Telco/Media processes (networks (5G, fiber), OSS/BSS systems, and media content delivery etc.) to craft tailored solutions.
* Stay abreast and advise on regulatory compliance, AI trends (LLMs for customer service, computer vision for media analytics, AI in real\-time streaming etc.).
* Champion adoption of AI, IoT, Digital Twins, Robotics and Edge Computing in solution architectures.


 Required Qualifications:
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience in solution architecture, consulting, or pre\-sales roles.
* Proven track record of solutioning large, complex deals in one or more of the target industries.
* Experience in crafting RFP/RFI responses and client\-specific solution presentations.
* Strong understanding of industry trends, digital transformation drivers, and operational challenges.
* Awareness of Energy \& Utilities domain (power generation, renewables, smart grids).
* Proficiency in cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and edge computing for in\-vehicle and plant\-level solutions.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams across geographies and service lines.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Exposure to OT, Industry 4\.0, AI/ML, GenAI, IoT, digital twins, and industry automation and smart manufacturing technologies.


 Preferred Attributes:
   

  

* Strategic thinker with ability to translate AI innovations into business value.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Passion for digital transformation in Energy \& Utilities.
* Ability to take an enterprise wide look as well as dig deeper in a technical problem posed by a customer.

4cb879c2.title: Solutions Architect
4cb879c2.description:
Responsible for leading the development of comprehensive solution architecture strategies, ensuring seamless integration of application solutions across teams and domains while maintaining robust technical foundations. The role involves collaboration with other architects to validate feasibility, oversee compliance with quality attributes, manage technical risks, and guide IT architects to enhance their solution architecture leadership skills, all while aligning with FedEx best practices and technological standards.
   

  

* Lead and define solution architecture strategies, encompassing technology and architecture for seamless integration of application solutions across various teams and domains.
* Establish and maintain the architectural runway at a solution level, ensuring a robust technical foundation for the rapid and reliable creation of new functionalities and features across teams and ARTs.
* Collaborate with other architects to validate the feasibility and sustainability of solution architectures and application portfolio lifecycle planning, ensuring alignment with FedEx best practices and design standards.
* Oversee the management of non\-functional requirements and compliance to ensure that solution architectures meet essential quality attributes such as performance, scalability, security, and maintainability, meeting stakeholder acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with other architects to define the appropriate delivery approach for solution services, encompassing processes, methodologies, tooling, and partnerships for agreement on service design and delivery.
* Identify and manage technical risks and continuous improvement opportunities for solution architectures, leveraging expert business knowledge to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
* Continuously monitor and evaluate new or emerging technologies utilized by internal teams, ensuring alignment with FedEx technological standards and potential integration into solution architectures.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to other IT architects to develop their skills and expertise in solution architecture leadership and execution.


 Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems and/or equivalent formal training or work experience. Relevant Master’s degree, TOGAF certification and SAFe Agile certification strongly preferred.
   

  

 Experience: Eight (8\) years equivalent work experience in information technology or engineering environment with a direct responsibility for strategy formulation and solution/technical architecture, as well as designing, architecting, developing, implementing and monitoring efficient and effective solutions to diverse and complex business problems.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Fluency in English
* Accuracy \& Attention to Detail
* Influencing \& Persuasion
* Planning \& Organizing
* Problem Solving
* Project Management


**Preferred Qualifications**
**Pay Transparency:**
**Pay**
**Additional Details:**
 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

54a4cede.title: Technical presales
54a4cede.description:
**Job Overview**
 We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Presales Engineer or Solution Engineer to support our cybersecurity practice. The role involves engaging with prospective clients, understanding their security requirements, preparing tailored proposals, coordinating with internal technical teams, and ensuring timely delivery of engagement documentation.
   

  

 This position bridges the gap between technical delivery and business development, making it ideal for someone with strong communication skills, a good grasp of cybersecurity services, and a client\-centric mindset.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities Collaborate with sales and delivery teams to prepare proposals, quotations, and engagement letters for cybersecurity services (e.g., VAPT, SOC 2, ISMS, configuration reviews). Understand client requirements, define scope, and map them to appropriate service offerings. Prepare project timelines, effort estimations, and commercial documents for client review. Participate in client meetings, client followups \& demos, and scoping discussions to support sales closure. Maintain a repository of proposal templates, case studies, and collateral for reuse. Coordinate with internal delivery teams for input on scope, methodology, and timelines \& preparing presentations. Support RFP/RFI responses by providing technical and commercial inputs. Track engagement status post\-proposal and assist in handover to the delivery team.
   

  

 Required Skills \& Experience 2–4 years of experience in presales, bid management, or client engagement in the IT or cybersecurity domain. Working knowledge of services such as Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing (VAPT), ISMS/ISO 27001, SOC 2, and IT GRC. Strong understanding of technical scoping and effort estimation concepts. Excellent written and verbal communication skills (client\-facing experience preferred). Proficiency in MS Office tools (Word, Excel, Power Point) and documentation best practices. Ability to coordinate across teams, manage multiple deliverables, and meet deadlines. Proactive \& Independent
   

  

 Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. Certifications such as CEH, or Comp TIA Security\+ (optional but preferred). Prior experience working with consulting or audit firms in cybersecurity or IT risk advisory.
   

  

 What We Offer Exposure to a wide range of cybersecurity domains and global clients. Opportunity to work closely with senior consultants and leadership. Dynamic and growth\-oriented environment with a focus on quality and innovation.

3778f9e1.title: Solution Engineer - GCC (FSI)
3778f9e1.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

 We are looking for world\-class Solution Engineers to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilise the value of the cutting\-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.
   

  

 The Solution Engineer will work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team on a handful of global accounts with GCCs in India to accelerate their Snowflake journey. The Solution Engineer will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer\-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof\-of\-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.
   

  

***This is a hands\-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***
 The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever\-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.
   

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers
* Work hands\-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing
* Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side
* Run training sessions, workshops, webinars to help customers become proficient in Snowflake
* Keeping customers up to date on key Snowflake product updates and future roadmaps to help them represent Snowflake to their clients about latest technology solutions and benefits
* Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions
* Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption
* Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events
* Forward Strategic thinking \- quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories \& case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake


**REQUIREMENTS:**
* Minimum 8\+ years of experience working in customer facing solution engineering (tech sales) role, preferably with large Global accounts
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science and data apps
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, in small groups or at public events, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Hands\-on expertise with SQL and Python
* Experience working with large global accounts, GSIs and/or Global Capability Centers
* Experience with large\-scale database technology (e.g. Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, Hadoop etc.)
* Pre\-sales experience in data related tech products
* Sound understanding and experience in the enterprise market and technology ecosystem
* Prior industry domain experience with a focus on BFSI is highly desirable.


**ADDED BONUS FOR:**
* Data Science/AI/ML experience across a variety of platforms
* Familiarity and experience with common BI and data exploration tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Metabase etc).
* Cloud Provider Experience \- Amazon AWS/Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  


**Job Description**



Are you ready to shape the next generation of enterprise automation while keeping mission\-critical workflows running smoothly?



As Tech Lead for the Automation Team, you will play a pivotal role in Husky’s transition from legacy workflow platforms to a modern, scalable automation landscape centered on the Microsoft Power Platform. You’ll lead by example—guiding your team in designing, governing, and delivering Power Apps and Power Automate solutions—while also ensuring the reliability, continuity, and evolution of existing automation solutions such as K2\.



This role sits at the intersection of innovation and responsibility: driving modernization, setting technical standards, and mentoring engineers, while safeguarding the automation backbone that supports our global business operations.



If you enjoy combining hands\-on technical leadership, platform thinking, and pragmatic enterprise automation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


**Responsibilities**


**Technical Leadership**


* Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
* Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD
* Technical direction for the product area
* Contribute to coordinating cross\-team dependencies and integration points


**Delivery \& Execution Excellence**


* Contribute to the feature definition and review
* Generate concepts and facilitate the concept selection
* Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks
* Helping with estimation and sprint planning
* Addressing technical impediments
* Own production readiness (incl. non\-functional requirements)


**Quality, Governance \& Security**


* Ensuring quality
* Conducting meaningful reviews and ensuring adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) / DoD (Definition of Done) criteria
* Ensure adherence to applicable standards, policies, and practices (e.g. DevSecOps)


**Incident Response**


* Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post\-mortems


**Mentorship \& Team Growth**


* Mentoring team members
* Documenting key design decisions
* Participate in interviews and hiring decisions
* Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams
* Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 10\+ years professional experience in software development, 5\+ years’ experience with Power Platform
* **Power Platform Expertise**
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including: Power Apps (Canvas \& Model Driven)
* Power Automate (cloud flows, approvals, error handling)
* Dataverse (data modeling, security, performance)
* Proven ability to design enterprise\-scale Power Platform solutions
* Strong understanding of solution layering, Application Lifecycle Management, and environment strategies
* **Power Platform Governance**
* Hands\-on experience implementing Power Platform governance, including DLP policies, environment strategies, Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit
* Strong understanding of: Role\-based security in Dataverse
* Tenant\-level Power Platform administration
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments (e.g., GDPR, ISO, SOC)
* **Azure \& Microsoft Ecosystem**
* Solid experience in integrating Power Platform with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Entra AD) and Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive)

Daily responsibilities include assessing existing infrastructure, defining cloud migration and modernization strategies, and creating architecture blueprints and documentation. The role involves collaborating with consulting, development, and operations teams to integrate applications, data, and services, as well as guiding performance optimization, security, and cost management. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
   

  

**Shape the Architecture Powering the World's Most Data\-Intensive Enterprises**
**About The Role**
 We're hiring a
 **Principal Architect** 
 to lead the architectural vision, design, and evolution of Teradata's core database platform at enterprise scale. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for a deeply technical leader who can shape long\-term platform strategy, set engineering standards, and influence outcomes across global teams. You'll be the highest\-level technical authority on database internals, query optimization, and large\-scale workload architecture—solving the problems that define what's possible in modern data platforms.

* Architect at enterprise scale – Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of Teradata core database architectures supporting massive, mission\-critical workloads
* Own performance and reliability – Drive query performance tuning, workload management, and system reliability, ensuring high availability and operational excellence across global deployments
* Set technical strategy – Act as the principal database subject matter expert, guiding architectural decisions and shaping long\-term platform evolution
* Lead through influence – Partner with engineering, analytics, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high\-performance data solutions
* Define what excellence looks like – Consistently deliver high\-impact architectural outcomes, raise the engineering bar, and enable innovation across teams


**Who You'll Work With**
 You'll join a high\-performing, collaborative team of database and analytics professionals based in
 **Hyderabad** 
 and across global locations. As a Principal Architect, you'll partner with engineering, analytics, infrastructure, and product teams on both regional and global initiatives. You'll work directly with senior technical leaders and executives, and report into the database and platform engineering organization.
   

  

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**
* 10\+ years of experience in database engineering, database architecture, or enterprise data platforms, with a track record of architecting large\-scale systems
* Deep expertise in database internals, SQL optimization, and workload management
* Advanced experience with query optimizer behavior and performance tuning in large\-scale, distributed environments
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and executive communication skills


**What You'll Bring**
* Experience defining and implementing best practices for data governance, data integrity, and database security, including compliance with Indian and global standards
* Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and influence technical leaders, fostering a culture of architectural excellence and continuous improvement
* A proactive mindset for identifying performance and architectural risks and driving optimization initiatives at platform scale
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to bridge global teams, enabling alignment, standards, and knowledge sharing across geographies


**Why Join Teradata as a Principal Architect?**
* Architect at the highest level – Shape platforms that power data and AI for the world's most demanding enterprises
* Strategic technical authority – Be the voice that defines long\-term direction, not just one of many engineers executing it
* Global influence, local presence – Lead architectural initiatives across continents from our Hyderabad office
* Work on hard problems – Tackle database challenges at a scale most engineers will never encounter


**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
 We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti\-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
   

  

 Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. This role will own operational stability, SLA performance, incident/problem/change management, platform governance, client stakeholder management, team leadership, and continuous service improvement. The ideal candidate should have strong experience managing L1/L2 support teams, managed services operations, cloud/platform environments, ITSM processes, and client\-facing delivery governance. The role requires a strong blend of technical operations leadership, service management discipline, people management, client communication, and continuous improvement mindset. Principal Responsibilities Service Delivery \& Operations Management Own end\-to\-end daily delivery for application support, platform management, technical operations, and managed services. Ensure performance to contractual commitments: SLAs/OLAs/KPIs, including service availability, responsiveness, and quality. Manage operational execution: ticket queues, backlog, triage, escalations, incidents, service requests, and production support routines. Lead operational governance cadence (daily/weekly/monthly) with internal teams and client stakeholders; track actions to closure. Ensure clean transition from project delivery into steady\-state support (handover readiness, support model, documentation, monitoring). Service Reporting, Metrics, Knowledge, \& Governance Packs Define and track operational KPIs such as SLA compliance, incident aging, MTTR, ticket trends, backlog reduction, first\-time\-right, reopen rate, change success rate, uptime, and CSAT. Produce monthly service reports, dashboards, exec summaries, and governance decks; provide clear narrative on drivers, risks, and mitigations. Analyze trends/recurring issues to identify root themes, automation candidates, and service improvement opportunities. Ensure operational artifacts are current and accurate: SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, RCA reports, and standard operating procedures. Application Support \& Platform Management Lead L1/L2 support across business applications, insurance platforms, data platforms, integrations, APIs, and cloud\-hosted services. Oversee monitoring, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, environment management, release support, and recurring operational activities. Ensure availability, performance, stability, and operational resilience; partner with engineering/product/infra/DevOps/QA/security for complex issues. Own major incident management: escalation handling, stakeholder communications, service restoration, and post\-incident follow\-through. Drive ITIL adherence across incident, problem, change, release, configuration, and knowledge management; participate in CAB and enforce change controls. Maintain operational readiness for releases/production changes (readiness checks, deployment support, rollback planning, coordination). Coordinate platform upgrades, patching, access management, configuration support, and environment readiness. Continuous Improvement, Automation \& Stakeholder Management Drive automation for repetitive support work (monitoring, alerting, reporting, workflows) to reduce manual effort, ticket volume, and MTTR. Promote proactive operations: preventive maintenance, problem elimination, self\-healing, and improved observability/alert quality. Implement best practices for service industrialization, shift\-left support, and knowledge reuse across tiers. Ensure compliance with internal policies, client requirements, audit controls, and security standards; maintain audit readiness. Manage operational risk: access reviews, vulnerability remediation coordination, privacy/regulatory alignment, DR/BCP and resilience procedures. Serve as primary delivery interface to client/business stakeholders; provide transparent updates on SLA performance, risks, issues, escalations, and improvement plans. Manage expectations during incidents/disruptions/releases and support QBRs and executive governance discussions. Team Leadership \& People Management Lead a multi\-role operations organization (service managers, technical leads, support engineers, platform analysts, operations specialists). Define operating model: org structure, role clarity, RACI/accountability, shift/coverage model, on\-call, and escalation matrix. Drive performance management, coaching/mentoring, training plans, utilization, and capability development aligned to service needs. Build a high\-performing culture focused on ownership, responsiveness, customer outcomes, quality, and continuous improvement. Support hiring, onboarding, resource planning, succession planning, and skill development across the team. Minimum Qualifications Degree \- Bachelors / Masters Working Experience 12\-18 years of overall IT experience. Minimum 6\-8 years in service delivery management, application support, technical operations, or managed services leadership. Experience managing L1/L2 application support teams in a client\-facing delivery environment. Strong exposure to ITIL processes, production support governance, incident/problem/change management, and SLA\-based delivery. Experience managing enterprise applications, web applications, APIs, integrations, data platforms, or cloud\-hosted platforms. Prior experience in insurance, financial services, and enterprise SaaS platforms will be preferred. Experience managing offshore/nearshore delivery teams and global stakeholders is highly desirable. Behavioral/Technical Skills; Competencies Must\-Have Skills Application Support / Production Support Management Platform Operations / Technical Operations ITIL / ITSM Process Management Incident, Problem, Change \& Release Management SLA / KPI / OLA Governance Client Stakeholder Management L2 / L3 Support Leadership Service Reporting \& Operational Dashboards Root Cause Analysis and Continuous Improvement Team Leadership and Resource Management Key Competencies Strong service ownership and accountability Excellent client\-facing communication Ability to manage ambiguity and high\-pressure production situations Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills People leadership and coaching capability Executive reporting and governance discipline Continuous improvement mindset Strong prioritization and escalation management Ability to balance technical depth with business impact Good\-to\-Have Skills Insurance domain platforms such as Insurity, Duck Creek, Guidewire, INSTANDA, AMS360, Sagitta, Epic, or similar platforms Cloud exposure: Azure / AWS DevOps tools: Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines Monitoring tools: AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Splunk, Datadog, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor ITSM tools: ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshservice, BMC Remedy Database exposure: SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Snowflake Integration/API understanding: REST APIs, middleware, ETL/data pipelines Automation exposure using PowerShell, Python, RPA, or AI\-enabled support tools

a23eb271.title: Consultant, Managed Services-AEP & AJO-Hyderabad,Chennai,Bengaluru,Pune
a23eb271.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**\#DFO\&I2027**
**Customer**
 The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology\-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level:** 
 Consultant, Managed Services or equivalent
   

  

 We are seeking an Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) Developer to build and operationalize marketing analytics and activation solutions. This role partners with Marketing, Product, and Data teams to deliver trusted customer data pipelines, identity resolution, segmentation, and cross\-channel journey orchestration, supported by strong engineering fundamentals in SQL, ETL, Python, cloud platforms, and data visualization.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 AEP / AJO delivery
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain AEP schemas, datasets, dataflows, and data governance\-aligned configurations to support marketing analytics and activation.
* Implement and optimize AJO journeys, message templates, and channel configurations (e.g., email/push/SMS, as applicable).
* Build and manage audience segmentation and support activation use cases (e.g., lifecycle, churn prevention, propensity\-driven journeys).
* Partner with stakeholders to translate marketing measurement needs into AEP/AJO technical designs (events, attributes, profile enablement, and downstream consumption).


 Data engineering (SQL / ETL / Python)
   

  

* Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest and transform data from sources such as CRM, web/app analytics, ad platforms, and transactional systems into AEP and analytics layers.
* Write high\-quality SQL for profiling, transformation, validation, and performance tuning across warehouses/lakes.
* Use Python for orchestration, automation, data quality checks, API integrations, and lightweight services/utilities supporting marketing data operations.
* Establish data quality controls: reconciliation, anomaly detection, lineage documentation, and runbook procedures.


 Cloud \& platform operations
   

  

* Build and operate solutions on cloud ecosystems (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP), leveraging managed services for compute, storage, orchestration, and monitoring.
* Implement secure data handling practices (PII controls, encryption, access management) and support audit/compliance requirements.
* Monitor and troubleshoot pipelines and journey execution; drive continuous improvements for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.


 Analytics enablement \& visualization
   

  

* Create curated datasets (semantic layers/marts) for marketing performance reporting and experimentation measurement.
* Build dashboards and automated reporting in tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker, enabling self\-service insights for marketers and executives.
* Define and support KPI frameworks (e.g., conversion, retention, LTV, attribution inputs), ensuring metric consistency across teams.


**The team:**
 Our
 **Digital Foundry Operate \& Innovations** 
 (DFO\&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end\-to\-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever\-evolving digital landscape.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* 3 \- 6 years of hands\-marketing data engineering, martech development, or marketing analytics engineering roles.
* Hands\-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) implementations in production environments.
* Strong SQL skills (complex joins, window functions, performance tuning, data modeling).
* Strong ETL/ELT experience (batch and/or streaming), including data validation and observability.
* Proficiency in Python for data workflows and automation.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and modern data stacks (data lake/warehouse concepts, orchestration, CI/CD).
* Experience delivering dashboards and analytical datasets for marketing and product stakeholders.


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Familiarity with customer identity resolution , event\-based data modeling , and customer 360/profile concepts.
* Experience with real\-time/event streaming (e.g., Kafka/Kinesis/ PubSub ) and/or API\-driven integrations.
* Knowledge of marketing measurement approaches (incrementality/experimentation, attribution concepts, funnel analytics).
* Exposure to data governance frameworks and marketing consent/privacy requirements.
* Experience implementing CI/CD , au tomated testing, and infrastructure\-as\-code (tooling varies).


 Technical skills (explicit)
   

  

* AEP/AJO: schemas/datasets/dataflows, segmentation, profiles, journey configuration, activation troubleshooting
* SQL: advanced querying, optimization, dimensional/ behavioral modeling
* ETL/ELT: pipeline design, orchestration, data quality/observability
* Python: automation, APIs, transformations, validation
* Cloud: AWS/Azure/GCP services for data \& analytics workloads; monitoring/logging
* Data visualization: Tableau / Power BI / Looker; KPI definitions and executive\-ready dashboards


 Success measures (example outcomes)
   

  

* Reduced time\-to\-activate audiences and launch journeys through reliable, documented pipelines.
* Improved marketing reporting trust via automated data quality checks and reconciliations.
* Increased adoption of dashboards and self\-service datasets across Marketing Analytics stakeholders.


**Education:**
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university


**Location:**
* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai


**Our purpose**

d0f3ac51.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you’ll work as Cyber Solution Specialist within the Operate Solution Hub, you will be responsible for coordinating the design of large and complex managed cybersecurity deals during the pursuits. The Solution Hub is designed to drive an optimum process for solutioning and pricing cross\-cyber\-domain managed security deals, reducing friction for cross\-Offering Portfolio pursuits and optimizing review. By providing services such as inputs for deal qualifications, cyber benchmarks/effort estimation, and solution/pricing review, the Cyber Operate Solution Hub will be a focused space to increase win rates and profitability.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Solution Hub team, you will be responsible for solution design and architecture activities.
   

  

* Support cyber solution analysis, business case development, and pricing model reviews across Infrastructure Security, Identity and Access Management, Security Operations Center services, Governance Risk and Compliance, and Vulnerability Management
* Assist Solution and Capability Architects in shaping managed cybersecurity offerings, including service tiers, cost structures, and pricing strategies
* Contribute to estimation frameworks and pricing models for cyber managed services, incorporating cross\-domain dependencies and cost drivers
* Support preparation of client\-facing materials and pursuit activities, including presentations, client discussions, orals, and due diligence
* Collaborate with pursuit stakeholders to refine solution designs, address service level agreement considerations, and align estimates with client requirements


**The team**
 Cyber Operate Practice is focused on helping our clients identify and manage the cyber risks arising from their association with third parties or service providers. We help our clients to define their overall third\-party cyber risk strategy, design and implement enterprise\-wide programs and technology that focus on identifying and reducing risks; help them evaluate their objectives, priorities, strengths and weaknesses and roll out large scale organizational changes to achieve goals.
   

  

**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in information security, cybersecurity, or technology engineering support
* Experience supporting solutioning for enterprise cybersecurity services across Infrastructure Security, Identity and Access Management, Security Operations Center services, Governance Risk and Compliance, and Vulnerability Management
* Experience developing business cases, estimation approaches, or pricing inputs for technology or managed service pursuits
* Experience contributing to cybersecurity managed service solution design across multiple security domains
* Experience working in matrixed teams during deal pursuits with changing requirements and timelines
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent


 Preferred:
   

  

* Master of Business Administration (MBA)

d07ca22a.title: Delivery Lead Manager
d07ca22a.description:
**Skill required:** 
 Financial Planning \& Analysis \- Financial Planning and Analysis (FP\&A)
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Delivery Lead Manager
   

  

**Qualifications:** 
 Any Graduation
   

  

**Years of Experience:** 
 13 to 18 years
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?** 
 The primary responsibility of the role is to proactively manage the delivery of Group Management and Statutory Reporting information in line with the agreed service level agreements by acting as a P\&L owner. Group Management information will include financial information and scenarios required for S\&OP meetings, H1 and FY targets. This will include challenging assumptions and coordination data inputs in all internal reporting systems, running the forecasting process activities, preparation and generation of financial information accurately and performing quality review with key finance senior stakeholders prior to releasing to the customer for approval. Drive independent analysis and provide insightful recommendations to the senior stakeholders. The objective of this role is to enable the Area Finance team to meet their business objectives by consolidating area financials, tracking actuals delivery vs budgets, providing key insights for Finance leadership team, as well as managing monthly dashboards and providing executive summary for Finance leadership team along with insights on key drivers. This role will partner senior stakeholders across various functional teams (Marketing Directors, Commercial Directors, Heads of Finance, Supply Chain Directors, etc) to provide strategic financial guidance on key financial performance in the market. Specific responsibilities include, but not limited to, overseeing financial forecasts, industry value projections, regulatory impacts to the category, price war analysis, etc. The ideal candidate will proactively and collaboratively work across the organization to develop a competitor framework that can effectively be used as a platform to provide insights revenue and resource allocation and drive recommendations on potential course of action. This position requires an excellent knowledge of financials, strategic thinking, analytical expertise, and leadership skills. information.
   

  

**What are we looking for?**
* Qualifications: CAs \& CFAs
* 8–12 years of progressive finance experience
* Proven track record in budgeting, forecasting, and strategic financial analysis.
* Experience in global FMCG / CPG / Tobacco industries or similar dynamic environments is an advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage teams, influence senior stakeholders, and drive process improvements.
* Advanced Excel (macros, pivot tables, etc.), ERP systems (SAP), FP\&A tools, BI dashboards, Alteryx, Agentic AI, Lean Six Sigma, Tableau
* Knowledge of FP\&A tools (SAP BPC, Hyperion, Anaplan,)
* In\-depth knowledge of P\&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow management.
* Strong ability to convey financial information clearly to senior leadership.
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to handle large volumes of data accurately.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills; able to work across all levels and functions.
* Ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and adapt to rapidly changing conditions.
* Ability to proactively identify risk, perform sensitivity analysis and drive risk mitigation
* Detail\-oriented, proactive, and capable of rational decision\-making and problem\-solving. Roles and Responsibilities:
* 
* Own / Lead the preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts, ensuring accuracy and alignment with business objectives.
* Conduct variance analysis on actual vs. budget/forecast, identify key drivers to the variances, analyze trends, risks, and opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations.
* Develop financial models for scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and long\-range forecasting to support strategic initiatives.
* Deliver timely and accurate financial reports and dashboards, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to influence decision\-making, optimize costs, and ensure resource allocation aligns with strategic priorities.
* Drive efficiency through automation and implement best practices for FP\&A processes, reporting, and data accuracy.
* Ensure adherence to financial policies, internal controls, and regulatory requirements across all FP\&A activities.
* Manage and mentor FP\&A analysts, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* Act as a vital member of the Consumer Leadership team in GBS, focusing on the Commercial Finance experience
* Support the Consumer Delivery Lead in creating value across product categories
* Present forecasts, performance, and potential risks/opportunities across all product lines including new categories and prepare strategies for senior stakeholders, considering competitor actions
* Perform financial modelling, sensitivity, and scenario analysis to accurately reflect the impact of proposed changes on the operating results of the business and to support informed business decisions.
* Evaluate the financial impact of regulatory change
* Lead and coordinate efforts for process improvement and efficiency within the commercial finance team, providing timely insights
* Undertake ad\-hoc projects as needed
* Contribute to developing integrated business strategies for portfolio, pricing, excise, and trade, considering all elements of the mix
* Conduct competitor reviews and share key insights with Top Management, incorporating them into pricing and excise discussions
* Establish governance and risk guidelines for pricing and excise activities to ensure strong controls and SOx compliance (where applicable, Any Graduation

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\) Enterprise AI Execution \& Operationalization:** Translate enterprise AI strategy into actionable roadmaps, delivery plans, and implementation milestones**.** Drive end\-to\-end execution of priority AI initiatives across multiple business areas. Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. Own delivery outcomes across initiatives, including scope, timelines, and measurable business impact.

**2\) Program \& Portfolio Delivery:** Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Establish and manage delivery discipline (prioritization, dependencies, timelines, risk mitigation). Ensure outcomes are tied to clear business value (e.g., productivity, growth, cost, risk). Drive integrated program plans, track KPIs and milestones, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, and execution challenges, escalating as needed.

**3\) Cross\-Enterprise Partnership** Partner with Business leaders across functions, Technology, Data \& Analytics team, and Risk, Legal, and Governance teams.Align stakeholders around what gets delivered and how, while shaping execution priorities and ensuring alignment to enterprise AI strategy. Engage senior leaders, including ELT stakeholders, to drive alignment, inform decision\-making, and ensure transparency on progress, risks, and outcomes. Act as a clear point of accountability for progress and results.

**4\) Technical \& Solution Leadership:** Provide informed direction on AI/ML and GenAI solutions to ensure fit\-for\-purpose design.Bridge strategy and execution by helping teams define use cases, select appropriate approaches/models, and ensure scalability and integration. Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and translate into practical application.

**5\) Adoption, Change \& Value Realization:** Drive business adoption of AI solutions, not just delivery. Define metrics and success measures and track realization of expected outcomes. Partner with HR / change / comms teams to support workflow integration and behavior change. Ensure value realization is clearly defined, tracked, and communicated, with a focus on measurable outcomes.

**6\) Governance \& Responsible AI:** Ensure adherence to enterprise AI governance, risk, and compliance frameworks. Operationalize responsible AI practices (e.g., transparency, fairness, controls). Support approval processes and risk assessments for AI deployments. Ensure alignment to the enterprise AI operating model, embedding best practices across data, technology, risk, talent, and change management.

**7\) Matrix Team Leadership:** Lead through influence and build strong execution capability and accountability across a broad cross\-functional team. Create consistency in delivery methodologies and standards. Foster a high\-performance, results\-oriented environment; drive clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement across teams.

**Required**

* Strong understanding of: AI/ML and GenAI applications, data platforms and enterprise technology environments

* Experience leading large\-scale programs or transformation initiatives with clear accountability for outcomes

**Preferred**

* Background balancing technical depth with program leadership

18e98606.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience managing the unique complexities and fast\-paced life\-cycle of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) software development projects.
* Experience in leading Agile transformations, with a track record of coaching and upskilling engineering teams in Agile delivery and ceremonies.
* Ability to apply program management fundamentals on technical cross\-functional projects (planning, execution, estimation, risk management, stakeholder management).


**About the job** 
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers. The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and drive the planning and execution of complex, cross\-functional engineering efforts within a specific domain or product area.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of Agile ceremonies and help software teams adopt and mature their Agile practices to improve efficiency.
* Implement governance structures for prioritization and execution within your assigned area to ensure alignment with key success metrics.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with technical and non\-technical stakeholders across teams to ensure project alignment and buy\-in.
* Use sound judgment to drive project planning, scheduling, execution, and communication, building consensus among team members and partners.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. 9fe443d6.title: Principal Program Manager
9fe443d6.description:
**Description**
 Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go\-to partner for the world’s most forward\-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting\-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI\-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI\-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.
   

  

**Overview**
 Synaptics is looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our Global Operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in semiconductor design and manufacturing processes, coupled with exceptional program management skills. As the ASIC Program Manager, you will oversee the entire product lifecycle from concept through production, working closely with cross\-functional teams including design, verification, validation, and manufacturing to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality ASICs. The successful candidate will play a key project leadership role, acting as the primary owner of SOC program execution on the project planning scheduling, inter\-team coordination, status tracking and reporting. Sr. Director, Program Management.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Competencies**
 Job Duties
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end program management of engineering programs from idea to mass production including planning, scoping, design, development, and change management
* Lead and coordinate all aspects of ASIC development programs from requirements gathering through to final product release, including design, verification, validation, and production rampup
* Work closely with internal engineering teams (ASIC design, firmware, validation, etc.), external partners, and vendors to manage deliverables and ensure alignment on project goals and schedules
* Support the teams in issue resolution and risk mitigation through well balanced and efficient processes leveraging tools and automation
* Actively support sustainable, effective cross\-functional communication at multiple levels in the organization
* Analyze technical issues and lead the team in generating creative mitigation options and solutions
* Act as the primary point of contact between engineering, product management, and senior leadership, providing regular status updates on program progress, issues, and risk management
* Monitor and manage the program budget, ensuring projects are delivered within financial constraints
* Manage relationships with operation team and external ASIC vendors, ensuring that they meet technical and delivery requirements
* Ensure proper documentation of program processes, designs, and decisions throughout the ASIC development lifecycle
* Drive continuous improvement of all processes, methodologies, and systems


 Competencies
   

  

* Well organized with strong attention to data and detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
* Ability to ask difficult but important questions and drive discussion to find answers
* Ability to influence horizontally across multiple internal functional organizations
* Developing talent, ability to inspire and excite team
* Highly structured planner with a strong discipline towards pragmatic and efficient processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in agile execution and facilitating multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to synthesize and report complex matters simply for senior and executive management to grasp quickly
* Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work within a diverse team


**Qualifications (Requirements)**
* Bachelor's (Master’s preferred) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent
* A deep understanding of ASIC design, verification, and manufacturing processes is essential.
* 15\+ years of experience in Program Management, including 5\+ years of expertise in engineering program management Experience in rigorous life\-cycle management including capturing requirements, decomposition, architecture, design, unit testing and integration testing among others
* Proven expertise in planning tools and methodologies (Jira, MS Project / SCRUM, waterfall)
* Hands\-on technical experience preferred
* No travel required


*Belief in Diversity
   

  

 Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information.*

68dc8470.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

* As a Senior Technical Program Manager at Qualys, you will drive the execution of complex, cross\-functional programs at the intersection of Threat Research, Product, and Platform Engineering. You will own end\-to\-end program delivery, translate deep technical work into measurable business outcomes, and ensure operational excellence in a high\-velocity cybersecurity environment.


 This role demands strong technical acumen, rigorous execution discipline, and the ability to influence across engineering, research, and executive leadership.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Planning \& Execution**
* Define program scope, success criteria, and dependencies; create and execute detailed quarterly and multi\-quarter program plans.
* Drive on\-time delivery of complex technical initiatives across research, engineering, and platform teams.
* Own program governance, milestone tracking, and execution cadence, including sprint planning and reviews.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Act as the primary interface (“API”) between Threat Research, Product Management, Platform Engineering, and Executive stakeholders.
* Identify downstream dependencies early, negotiate timelines, and resolve conflicts to prevent execution bottlenecks.
* Hold engineering and research teams accountable to commitments while fostering strong collaboration and trust.
* Risk, Dependency \& Incident Management
* Proactively identify technical, operational, and delivery risks; define mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
* Translate technical blockers and security risks into clear business impact statements for leadership and product stakeholders.
* Demonstrate resilience and decisiveness in high\-pressure environments such as SOC, Threat Research, or Incident Response operations.
* Technical Ownership \& Domain Expertise
* Own and manage the Threat Research execution queue, ensuring alignment with product and platform priorities.
* Apply a strong understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape, including CVEs, CVSS scoring, exploit maturity (PoC vs. weaponized exploits), and vulnerability lifecycle.
* Ensure seamless handoff of research outputs into productization and engineering workflows.
* Metrics, Dashboards \& Reporting
* Define and track KPIs to measure program health, delivery performance, risk posture, and operational efficiency.
* Design, script, and maintain automated dashboards using tools such as JIRA, Salesforce, Tableau, APIs, SQL, or Python.
* Deliver clear, data\-driven insights to technical teams and executive leadership.
* Process Excellence \& Tooling
* Configure, maintain, and optimize program management tools (JIRA, Salesforce, Confluence) to support scalable execution.
* Drive continuous improvement of workflows, operating models, and Agile practices to enhance efficiency and quality.
* Own the team’s information architecture in Confluence, enforcing a “documentation\-first” culture—no operational process exists unless it is documented.
* Required Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or Project Management within technology\-driven organizations.
* Strong expertise in SDLC, Agile methodologies, and program execution at scale.
* Hands\-on experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and reporting platforms.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced, evolving, and high\-stakes environments.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Experience working in the cybersecurity domain, including vulnerability management, threat research, SOC, or incident response.
* Familiarity with SQL and/or Python for data extraction, analysis, and reporting.
* Experience supporting or leading programs involving security research, platform engineering, or cloud\-scale products.

76ef66db.title: Global Strategic Account Manager - Technical Architect
76ef66db.description:
**Job Description**
**Who we are:**
 Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.
   

  

 For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As GSAM \- Technical Architect, you will be responsible for Leads design, positioning, and technical execution of advanced thermal and cooling solutions for global data center customers. Acts as a trusted advisor aligning customer requirements with optimized, scalable, and energy\-efficient architectures across chiller, liquid cooling, and central plant systems. Partners closely with Global Strategic Account Managers (GSAMs) to align technical solutions with account strategy, drive customer engagement, and accelerate deal conversion. Serves as a global customer advocate, ensuring alignment between customer needs, solution delivery, and long\-term partnership objectives.
   

  

**How You Will Do It**
* Architect end\-to\-end thermal solutions (air\-cooled, liquid cooling, hybrid systems) aligned with hyperscale and colocation requirements
* Translate customer technical requirements into optimized system designs, including capacity modeling and performance trade\-offs
* Lead technical components of proposals, including system architecture, energy efficiency modeling, and solution differentiation
* Partner with Global Strategic Account Managers (GSAMs) to align solution strategy with account priorities, customer engagement plans, and pipeline development
* Serve as a global customer advocate, representing customer requirements internally across engineering, product, and operations to drive alignment and delivery
* Lead and support program management of complex, multi\-region data center initiatives, ensuring coordination across stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables
* Support pricing and commercial strategy through technical value articulation (TCO, PUE, lifecycle cost)
* Act as technical interface between customer engineering teams and JCI product/engineering organizations
* Drive innovation adoption (e.g., high\-density liquid cooling, advanced chillers, heat reuse)


 Operating Rhythms
   

  

* Joint engagement with GSAMs in strategic account planning, global customer governance, and executive technical discussions
* Lead global customer advocacy forums to align technical roadmaps, performance expectations, and long\-term partnership objectives
* Program management cadence across large\-scale deployments, ensuring alignment on scope, schedule, and delivery milestones
* Technical design workshops with customers focused on future state architectures and AI workloads
* Proposal development cycles with cross\-functional engineering, product, commercial teams, and GSAM leadership
* Quarterly solution and program reviews aligned to customer roadmap, capacity plans, and technology evolution
* Ongoing engagement with product teams to influence roadmap based on customer requirements


**What We Look For**
* Bachelor’s degree with 10\+ years of proven experience in data center cooling systems (chillers, CDU, CRAH/CRAC, liquid cooling).
* Expertise in thermal system design and capacity planning.
* Strong background in energy efficiency optimization (PUE, WUE, sustainability targets).
* Skilled in global customer advocacy and stakeholder management.
* Experience in program and project management across complex, multi‑region deployments.
* Knowledge of hyperscale and colocation standards.
* Ability in technical sales and solution positioning in partnership with GSAM organizations.
* Proven cross‑functional leadership across engineering, sales, and operations.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary
* Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
