 Results\-CX is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factors under federal, state, or local law.

797bfd67.title: Solutions Architect
797bfd67.description:
Responsible for leading the development of comprehensive solution architecture strategies, ensuring seamless integration of application solutions across teams and domains while maintaining robust technical foundations. The role involves collaboration with other architects to validate feasibility, oversee compliance with quality attributes, manage technical risks, and guide IT architects to enhance their solution architecture leadership skills, all while aligning with FedEx best practices and technological standards.
   

  

* Lead and define solution architecture strategies, encompassing technology and architecture for seamless integration of application solutions across various teams and domains.
* Establish and maintain the architectural runway at a solution level, ensuring a robust technical foundation for the rapid and reliable creation of new functionalities and features across teams and ARTs.
* Collaborate with other architects to validate the feasibility and sustainability of solution architectures and application portfolio lifecycle planning, ensuring alignment with FedEx best practices and design standards.
* Oversee the management of non\-functional requirements and compliance to ensure that solution architectures meet essential quality attributes such as performance, scalability, security, and maintainability, meeting stakeholder acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with other architects to define the appropriate delivery approach for solution services, encompassing processes, methodologies, tooling, and partnerships for agreement on service design and delivery.
* Identify and manage technical risks and continuous improvement opportunities for solution architectures, leveraging expert business knowledge to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
* Continuously monitor and evaluate new or emerging technologies utilized by internal teams, ensuring alignment with FedEx technological standards and potential integration into solution architectures.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to other IT architects to develop their skills and expertise in solution architecture leadership and execution.


 Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems and/or equivalent formal training or work experience. Relevant Master’s degree, TOGAF certification and SAFe Agile certification strongly preferred.
   

  

 Experience: Eight (8\) years equivalent work experience in information technology or engineering environment with a direct responsibility for strategy formulation and solution/technical architecture, as well as designing, architecting, developing, implementing and monitoring efficient and effective solutions to diverse and complex business problems.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Fluency in English
* Accuracy \& Attention to Detail
* Influencing \& Persuasion
* Planning \& Organizing
* Problem Solving
* Project Management


**Preferred Qualifications**
**Pay Transparency:**
**Pay**
**Additional Details:**
 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

Thank you for your interest in joining Solventum. Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/legal/website\-privacy\-statement/applicant\-privacy/ applies to any personal information you submit. As it was with 3M, at Solventum all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Data Analytics Solution Architect
   

  

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**
**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game\-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**
**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**
**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**
 As an IT Solution Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing IT solutions that meet business requirements and align with the organization's strategic goals. You will work closely with stakeholders to understand their needs, develop architectural frameworks, and ensure the successful delivery of IT projects. Your role will involve evaluating technologies, creating solution designs, and providing technical leadership.
   

  

 As a Solution Architect, You Will Have The Opportunity To Tap Into Your Curiosity And Collaborate With Some Of The Most Innovative And Diverse People Around The World. Here, You Will Make a Significant Impact By Shaping And Delivering Robust Data Analytics Solutions. Here, You Will Make An Impact
   

  

* Lead End\-to\-End Solution Architecture: Drive the comprehensive data architecture across a diverse ecosystem, including Snowflake, dbt,SAP S/4HANA/ECC \& Datasphere, MS Dynamics 365, BPCS, Salesforce, Workday, Concur, Oracle, JDE, MES, and various external data sources.
* Design Integrated Data Solutions: Architect highly integrated data models that effectively support critical business domains such as Commercial Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and others.
* Translate and Optimize Data for Analytics: Transform complex Enterprise Application and ERP transactional and master data into optimized, analytics\-ready structures within Snowflake and other downstream platforms.
* Standardize Key Business Metrics: Define and standardize crucial business metrics and KPIs across IT, finance, sales, supply chain, customer operations, and manufacturing domains to ensure consistent reporting and analysis.
* Design and Implement Data Pipelines: Design and oversee the implementation of efficient data pipelines and ELT frameworks utilizing tools like AWS, S3, Lambda, \& Step functions, SAP Datasphere, HVR, Fivetran, and Informatica.
* Integrate Diverse Data Sources: Lead the integration of ERP (SAP, MS D365, BPCS, Oracle, JDE) and Non\-ERP (Salesforce, Workday, Concur, MES, external sources, etc.) data with Snowflake or other cloud data lakes, adhering to best practices for data quality, scalability, and performance.
* Ensure Data Solution Robustness: Collaborate closely with data engineers to ensure the development of robust, well\-documented Source\-to\-Target Mappings (STTMs).
* Deliver Data Models for Reporting: Support critical operational and reporting requirements by delivering comprehensive data models for regulatory, financial, and management reporting.
* Provide Technical Oversight for Data Access: Offer technical oversight for data access strategies (ODP, CDS Views, APIs), ensuring optimal operational efficiency and performance.
* Guide Data Issue Resolution: Lead the troubleshooting of data issues in production environments and collaborate with support teams to identify and resolve root causes.
* Contribute to Data Governance: Actively contribute to data governance practices by ensuring data lineage, stewardship, and metadata are deeply embedded within the architectural designs.
* Ensure Data Compliance: Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure all data designs and usage adhere to GDPR/SOX compliance standards.
* Act as a Strategic Data Advisor: Serve as the primary data advisor to business and IT stakeholders, ensuring strong alignment between data capabilities and overarching business goals.
* Lead Architectural Design Sessions: Facilitate and lead architecture sessions with functional consultants, product owners, and analysts to validate designs and drive successful solution adoption.


**Your Skills And Expertise**
 To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3MHealth requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree or higher AND 8 years of data analytics experience


 AND
   

  

 In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:
   

  

* 8–12 years in Solution Architecture or related roles, with at least 5 years of SAP\-specific data modeling experience \& 3 years of experience as Data Architect.
* Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring a team of data engineers or similar technical roles.
* Strong knowledge of ERPs such as SAP S/4HANA/ECC, and Datasphere, from a solution integration perspective.
* Hands\-on with Snowflake, data modeling, SQL, Data Vault or Star Schema modeling, and SQL, applied in a solution design context.
* Familiarity with integration tools like HVR, Fivetran, or Informatica, understanding their application in end\-to\-end solutions.
* Deep understanding of key business metrics in IT, finance, sales, logistics, and manufacturing, and how they translate into data solutions.
* Ability to translate business requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and build consensus across diverse teams.
* Collaborative, agile mindset with ability to operate in cross\-functional teams and demonstrate leadership within those teams.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments is a plus


 Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
   

  

* 1 year of experience with Salesforce, Workday, Concur or any other Enterprise application, specifically concerning data integration and solutioning.
* 2 years with ML/AI, advanced analytics, or data science software, understanding how these can be integrated into broader data solutions.
* Skills include: data engineering principles, Data Governance frameworks, effective oral and written communication with senior leadership and front\-line developers, strategic thinking, technical leadership, and prior experience building and developing high\-performing engineering teams focused on data solutions.


 For current employees, internal transfer restrictions may not apply. For more details, contact your local recruiter/HR team.
   

  

**Work location:** 
**Bangalore,** 
**Hybrid**

 Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.
   

  

 Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.
   

  

 Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of

 Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at Solventum are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.

* Azure DevOps or GitHub

**Assets**

* Experience setting up or running a Power Platform Center of Excellence
* Prior experience in citizen development enablement

**Why Husky?**

73b79e4b.title: Solutions Engineer
73b79e4b.description:
**\#\# About Vitracx** 




 Vitracx builds LocOS — a real\-time location platform that helps manufacturing plants track assets, WIP, and equipment indoors and outdoors, combining UWB, BLE, RFID, and GPS in one system. We work with automotive OEMs and Tier\-1 suppliers, steel, cable, and glass manufacturers across India. We're a small, fast\-moving team building the software platform and implementing at enterprise customer sites.
 



  





**\#\# The Role** 




 We're looking for someone to own the technical journey with our customers — from the first scoping conversation through installation, go\-live, and ongoing support. You'll be the person who turns a customer's shop\-floor problem into a working deployment, and the main point of contact with our hardware partners when something needs fixing.
 



  





**\#\# What You'll Do** 



* Join early sales conversations to scope feasibility and design PoCs alongside our sales team
* Run site surveys, oversee hardware installation and calibration, and configure the platform for go\-live
* Independently troubleshoot field issues — connectivity, calibration, false triggers — and know when to escalate a genuine hardware/design issue
* Be our primary technical contact with hardware vendors for firmware and configuration issues
* Track timelines across multiple live projects and keep customers, vendors, and our internal team aligned\- Support our field engineer on issues that need deeper technical digging



  





**\#\# What We're Looking For** 



* Engineering degree — Electronics/Communication, Instrumentation, Mechanical, or related
* 3–5 years in field engineering, industrial automation, wireless/networking deployment, or systems integration
* Comfortable with wireless fundamentals (BLE, RF, Wi\-Fi); prior RTLS/UWB exposure is a strong plus but not required
* Can read vendor technical documentation and hold your own in a technical conversation with a hardware vendor's engineering team
* Strong communicator — able to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders (plant managers, IT heads)
* Comfortable with frequent travel across project sites in India

 Miitz International is a new India\-based startup focused on delivering “Made in India” green products and solutions under one roof. The role also requires maintaining up\-to\-date knowledge of AV technologies, standards, and integration practices to support high\-quality, sustainable solutions.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong knowledge of audio\-visual systems design, including displays, sound systems, control systems, and AV signal distribution.
* Experience supporting presales activities such as requirements gathering, solution design, proposal creation, and technical presentations.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and building layouts for AV and automation integration.
* Familiarity with building automation, networking basics, and integration of AV systems into smart building or energy\-efficient environments.
* Proficiency in using design and documentation tools (e.g., CAD software, Visio, or similar) for creating AV layouts and schematics.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with clients, sales teams, and technical staff in a collaborative manner.
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail and the ability to estimate costs and prepare competitive technical offers.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Engineering, Electronics, Electrical, Telecommunications, or a related technical field.
* Prior experience in AV engineering, system integration, or technical presales roles is preferred.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Chennai and occasionally visit client locations as required.

2a953e2b.title: AI Data Architect
2a953e2b.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**Your role:**

  

The ideal candidate will define and lead the target\-state AI data architecture across all lifecycle stages—from initial transition and Day 1 operations to ongoing BAU support and continuous optimization. In this role, you will architect mechanisms to ingest, prepare, and structure complex enterprise data sources (including ServiceNow, CMDB, knowledge bases, code repositories, monitoring feeds, and operational logs) for seamless AI agent consumption. You will design governed Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, semantic search models, vector indexing strategies, knowledge graphs, and scalable data products tailored for agentic workflows. Crucially, you will enforce strict data governance, ensuring all data accessed by AI agents remains highly accurate, permission\-aware, traceable, auditable, and compliant with customer privacy and data boundary standards. Additionally, you will provide cross\-functional architectural leadership to AI Data Engineers, Agent Engineers, Forward Deploy Engineers, Solution Architects, and customer stakeholders to align data strategy with operational objectives.
  

  

**What you will do:**

* **End\-to\-End Data Architecture:** Design blueprints and canonical models for ingesting, enriching, and serving operational enterprise data (ServiceNow, CMDB, Git, SharePoint, SOPs) to AI agents.
* **Agentic Data Enablement:** Architect governed APIs, retrieval services, context packages, and structured output schemas for multi\-agent workflows and Agent Builder platforms.
* **RAG \& Search Strategy:** Define enterprise RAG models, chunking/indexing policies, hybrid search patterns, and vector database topologies (Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector).
* **Data Quality \& Benchmarking:** Establish quality thresholds, retrieval precision/recall metrics, and golden evaluation datasets to measure drift and optimize response accuracy.
* **Security \& Access Governance:** Enforce Zero Trust data access, RBAC/ABAC, data boundaries, privacy masking, and lineage logging across all AI retrieval and model interaction layers.
* **Cloud \& Platform Blueprinting:** Architect scalable data pipelines, storage, and lakehouse/vector infrastructure across Azure, GCP, AWS, Databricks, or Snowflake landing zones.
* **AMS Domain Modeling:** Map ITSM and Application Management Services operational workflows (incidents, CMDB, SLAs) into high\-value data products for automated ticket analysis and runbook generation.
* **Engineering Leadership:** Provide architectural direction to Forward Deploy and Data Engineers while managing standards for performance, cost, security, and production readiness.

Your Future at Kyndryl
  

The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


**Required Technical and Professional Experience**
--------------------------------------------------

* **AI \& Agentic Data Architecture:** 10\+ years in enterprise data/platform architecture, with 3\+ years specifically building GenAI, RAG, and AI agent data models using frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and AutoGen.
* **LLM, RAG \& Vector Platforms:** Expertise in context management, grounding, chunking, and hybrid search across vector engines (Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector) and major LLMs (Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Llama).
* **Enterprise Data \& Storage:** Deep experience in canonical and semantic data modeling, data products, lakehouses, and modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Fabric) across Azure, GCP, or AWS.
* **AMS \& ITSM Domain Expertise:** Proven track record with ServiceNow, CMDB models, ticket workflows, SLA analytics, and transforming operational IT assets into AI\-ready data products.
* **Governance, Security \& Lineage:** Strong capability in designing Zero Trust data access (RBAC/ABAC), data mesh concepts, lineage tracking, privacy controls, and audit frameworks for enterprise compliance.
* **Evaluation \& Lifecycle Quality:** Skilled in establishing evaluation datasets, drift detection, retrieval performance metrics (precision/recall), and agent contract schemas to eliminate hallucinations.
* **Consulting \& Stakeholder Leadership:** Ability to facilitate workshops, drive data discovery under ambiguity, run architecture reviews, and align multi\-disciplinary engineering and business teams.
* **Core Artifact Ownership:** Responsible for delivering AI Data Blueprints, RAG/vector strategies, source\-to\-target mappings, governance frameworks, and data engineering implementation guidelines.

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Master Degree \& any relevant certification

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

8a7dabd7.description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

**Principal Digital Architect – Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) (SG25\)**

 **Role Definition**


The Principal Digital Architect – Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) is responsible for defining, designing, and governing enterprise\-scale content management and digital experience architectures with Adobe Experience Manager as the core platform.


This role provides hands\-on architectural leadership to translate business, brand, and customer experience strategies into scalable, secure, and extensible AEM\-based solutions, aligned with Cat Digital and enterprise architecture standards.


The role acts as the AEM technical authority and trusted advisor across Marketing, IT, Engineering, Data, and Security teams—ensuring successful adoption, integration, performance, and value realization of AEM within the broader Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**AEM Architecture Strategy \& Target Design**

* Assess current\-state content, web, and digital experience ecosystems and define future\-state AEM\-centric architectures aligned with business objectives and omnichannel experience strategies.
* Develop AEM solution architectures, reference patterns, and content delivery roadmaps (Sites, Assets, Headless, Edge Delivery Services).
* Define architecture approaches for multi\-site, multi\-brand, multi\-region implementations.
* Ensure AEM architectures meet enterprise standards for scalability, performance, security, compliance, and operational readiness.
* Drive architectural decisions through trade\-off analysis and Architectural Decision Records (ADRs).

 **Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Architecture Leadership**

* Lead architecture and solution design across Adobe Experience Manager, including:
* AEM Sites (authoring, templating, components)
* AEM Assets (DAM, Dynamic Media, renditions, workflows)
* Headless AEM (Content Fragments, GraphQL, APIs)
* Edge Delivery Services / Headless Delivery patterns
* AEM Authoring, Publishing, Dispatcher/CDN architectures
* AEM cloud\-native deployments (AEM as a Cloud Service)
* AEM Guides (documentation and structured content)
* Define and enforce Adobe\-recommended architecture patterns, cloud service best practices, and extensibility models.
* Provide architectural guidance on component design, content modeling, caching, performance optimization, and authoring governance.
* Partner with delivery teams to reduce technical risk, rework, and long\-term maintenance costs.

 **Integration with Adobe Experience Platform \& MarTech Ecosystem**

* Architect integrations between AEM and Adobe Experience Platform, including:
* Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)
* Real\-Time Customer Data Platform (RT\-CDP)
* Adobe Target, Analytics, and Customer Journey Analytics
* Adobe Journey Optimizer, Campaign, and Marketo Engage
* Define personalization and activation patterns using AEM \+ AEP \+ Target.
* Design event\-driven and API\-based integrations between AEM and enterprise systems (commerce, CRM, identity, product data).

 **Data, Identity \& Integration Architecture**

* Define content, customer, and experience data models aligned across AEM and AEP.
* Architect secure integration patterns using REST APIs, events, messaging, CDN, and cloud\-native services.
* Ensure identity, consent, and privacy\-by\-design principles are embedded into AEM\-driven experiences.
* Drive data quality, lineage, and compliance considerations in all architecture designs.

 **Architecture Governance \& Delivery Enablement**

* Provide architectural leadership across global, multi\-vendor delivery teams.
* Define and enforce AEM architecture standards, guardrails, and governance models.
* Review solution designs for performance, scalability, authoring usability, security, and operational excellence.
* Actively identify architectural risks and recommend mitigation strategies across delivery lifecycle.

 **Stakeholder \& Executive Engagement**

* Partner with Marketing, Brand, IT, Data, Security, and Engineering leaders to align AEM capabilities with business and CX outcomes.
* Translate complex AEM and MarTech architectures into clear, value\-focused narratives for executive and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Support executive decision\-making through concise architecture artifacts, options analysis, and recommendations.


We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

  

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.

 **Work Experience**  

**Architecture \& Leadership**

* Enterprise solution and platform architecture experience
* Architecture governance, standards definition, and design reviews
* Requirements decomposition and solution structuring
* Trade\-off analysis (cost, scalability, extensibility, time\-to\-value)
* Influencing and leading without authority across functions

**Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) – Core**

* Deep hands\-on AEM architecture experience (Sites, Assets, Headless)
* AEM Cloud Service architecture and deployment models
* Author–Publish–Dispatcher/CDN architecture patterns
* Component design, content modeling, templates, workflows
* Performance optimization, caching strategies, scalability patterns
* AEM extensibility (OSGi, Sling Models, APIs, integrations)

**Integration \& Platform**

* REST APIs and event\-driven integration patterns
* Cloud\-native architectures (AWS or equivalent)
* Security, identity, and privacy\-by\-design principles
* Experience working with large\-scale, global AEM implementations

 **Nice to Have Skills (Preferred)**

* Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and RT\-CDP
* Adobe Target, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics
* Adobe Journey Optimizer, Campaign, or Marketo Engage
* Headless CMS patterns and frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, Edge delivery)
* Personalization and experimentation platforms
* Workfront integration and content supply chain optimization
* Experience in B2B, B2C, or multi\-brand enterprise environments

 **Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 14–16 years of experience in enterprise digital architecture or large\-scale platform design.
* Demonstrated experience architecting AEM\-led enterprise digital experience platforms.
* Experience working with global, multi\-region delivery teams.

 **Level Expectations**

* Provides deep expert\-level architectural leadership within the AEM and digital experience domain.
* Owns complex architectural problem\-solving from strategy through execution.
* Leads evaluation and adoption of new AEM and digital experience capabilities.
* Influences platform direction and delivery outcomes through technical credibility and clarity.

91275c18.title: Cloud Solution Architect - AI Biz Solutions
91275c18.description:
**Overview**
 Proactively acts as the voice of the customer/partner and internal communities leveraging relevant insights from feedback tools and systems. Identifies and/or translates customer/partner problems into industry solutions. Drives self and guides other team members to focus on customer/partner experience through efficient delivery and ensuring a seamless and connected customer experience. Proactively identifies, escalates, and mitigates blockers using appropriate tools. Delivers solutions in line with company methodologies, ensuring proven practices and patterns are followed. Proactively identifies new opportunities for Consumption, Usage \& Unified expansion at scale. Operates according to required operational excellence and proven practice standards throughout all sales stages/activities/tools of record. Leverages market insights and demand signals. Contributes to leading virtual teams using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape. Proactively identifies gaps that enable solutions to scale across customers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Business Impact**
 Operates according to required operational excellence and proven practice standards throughout all sales stages/activities/tools of record (e.g., pipeline updates, time tracking). Collaborates across Microsoft and customer/partner teams through on\-strategy delivery to achieve customer/partner objectives and increase customer/partner satisfaction. Proactively manages business and technical risks, adapts methodology and applies governance principles to identify, communicate, and minimize business and technical risks. Executes work in compliance with industry and Microsoft guidelines and procedures. Continuously prioritizes among competing demands in their work and identifies where impact occurs with customers, ensuring alignment with business priorities and goals.
   

  

 Delivers solutions in line with company methodologies (e.g., product offerings such as value\-based deliverables \[VBDs], advice, training, technical validation), ensuring proven practices and patterns are followed to prepare customers for operational readiness and achievement of their business goals and targets. Leveraging knowledge of change management proven practices and/or involving the change management team, proactively helps the customer deploy for long\-term organizational adoption to increase customer satisfaction and drive consumption/usage. Guides customers/partners towards a well\-architected (e.g., secure, resilient, artificial intelligence \[AI]\-enabled), and cost\- and performance\-optimized solution to increase retention and expansion opportunities. Provides feedback to Unified Delivery Team on VBDs to refine and further develop content.
   

  

 Proactively identifies new opportunities for Consumption, Usage \& Unified expansion (especially Enhanced Solutions) at scale based on business value to customer/partner and clear understanding of the Microsoft value proposition for supported platforms to empower cloud success, foster and strengthen security and resiliency, and drive AI innovation. Actively listens to and respectfully challenges customers/partners, building trust to then advocate for alternative architectures/solutions/approaches that shape and/or enhance customer requirements. Identifies, and evaluates industry trends (e.g., customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry), gathers customer/partner insights (e.g., feedback around technical preferences, environments, business needs, competitive landscape), and maps existing architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes. Proactively captures opportunities in appropriate systems, processes, and tools, working collaboratively across the organization to execute on opportunities aligned with Microsoft's Customer Engagement Model.
   

  

 Proactively identifies, escalates, and mitigates blockers using appropriate tools and processes to accelerate solution deployment, value realization and usage/consumption. Applies business, technical, industry, and/or enterprise knowledge to architecture or support projects to meet business and information technology (IT) requirements and resolve identified constraints.
   

  

**Customer Centricity**
 Proactively acts as the voice of the customer/partner, sharing ideas, feedback, insights, success stories and strategic/technical input with Engineering teams, Product Offerings teams and internal communities leveraging relevant insights from feedback tools and systems. Identifies patterns of feedback across customers/partners/territories/industries and leverages them to develop strategic and actionable insights. Presents business cases to program managers to influence product roadmaps, decision making, bug fix prioritization, and own and drive initiatives as appropriate.
   

  

 Identifies and/or translates customer/partner problems into industry solutions aligned with Microsoft product and platform strategy, and explains why and/or how they meet customer/partner outcomes and return on investment (ROI) goals (e.g., via proof of concept, minimally viable product \[MVP], rapid prototype) relative to competitive offerings. Proactively helps the customer/partner adopt and use Microsoft product/platform strategy\-aligned (cross\-solution area) solutions. Builds relationships with technical decision makers (TDMs), and helps build the bridge between TDMs and business decision makers (BDMs). Independently interacts as needed with customers/partners' Chief Information Officer (CIO), Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and other C\-level (CXO) roles to bridge understanding of security, compliance, operational and risk requirements across BDMs, TDMs, CIO and CISO teams, appropriately engaging additional subject matter experts when deeper expertise is required.
   

  

 Drives self and guides other team members to focus on customer/partner experience through efficient delivery and ensuring a seamless and connected customer experience. Defines customer/partner conditions of success by leveraging an understanding of customer goals. Anticipates and addresses customer/partner dissatisfaction and unmet needs, and executes strategies to improve customer experience, value realization, and acceleration of transformation.
   

  

**Partner Specialization**
 Identifies and prioritizes several opportunities that align with revenue goals, and orchestrates growth of solution utilization pipeline with partners. Provides assistance with partner and sales teams to bring clarity to specific opportunities through proof of concept and technical pre\-sales support.
   

  

 Understands solution area\-specific market opportunities (e.g., competitor insights) and collaborates with Global Partner Solutions (GPS) business stakeholders to lead and execute initiatives to translate opportunities into actions. Proactively guides and supports partners in developing repeatable offerings, practices, products, and solutions. Advises the partner throughout initial strategic customer implementations.
   

  

**Technical Leadership**
 Leverages market insights and demand signals to assist leadership in identifying relevant areas in which to drive up\-skilling and/or accreditations based on demand. Role models technical readiness, both depth\-aligned to solution area priorities and breadth\-aligned to Customer Success Unit (CSU)/corporate initiatives (e.g., security, resilience, AI), and influences team to drive their own technical readiness. Acts as a mentor, leading readiness and upskilling activities in the team/organization by educating colleagues on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing proven practices.
   

  

 Contributes to leading virtual teams (v\-teams) around technologies and customer/partner challenges, and shares ideas, insights, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape. Demonstrates strong industry knowledge and increases recognition for Microsoft solutions by contributing to and sometimes leading presentations and engagements with external and internal audiences (e.g., Tech Connect, Build, Ignite) Contributes to intellectual property (IP) and identifies patterns where no IP exists (e.g., CoPilot and AI scenarios) to help build scalable and repeatable models. Participates in external technical and non\-technical community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, webcasts, blogs, hackathons) that elevate the Microsoft brand and shares learnings across internal teams.
   

  

 Proactively identifies gaps through delivery, communicates those gaps to relevant team members and internal/external stakeholders, and connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas that drive changes and improvements to products, intellectual property (IP) (both existing and new), technologies, and/or processes/practices that enable solutions to scale across customers. Contributes to the development and modification of Microsoft's structured frameworks and methodologies. Provides thought leadership and innovation to customers/partners and internal communities at the local level.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Driving Customer Outcomes** 
 \- Understanding and mapping customer requirements to the company's offerings effectively. Identifying opportunities, translating customer needs into tailored solutions, ensuring that products or services precisely meet customer expectations, resulting in high levels of satisfaction and success.
   

  

* Business Relationship Management \- The ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with supervisors, staff, managers, customers, and vendors. This includes expressing empathy and compassion when dealing with the needs and problems of others, being approachable, taking time to address the concerns of coworkers, and treating others with respect and dignity.
* Change Management \- The ability to define and implement procedures and/or technologies to deal with changes in the environment. This may include adapting to change, controlling change, and/or affecting change.
* Customer Advocacy \- Knowledge of Customer Advocacy, a continuing focus on the requirements of the company’s customers, anticipating their needs, remaining sensitive to customers while performing services for them, being responsive to customer requests, generally working on their behalf.
* Trusted Advisor \- The ability to build trusted advisor status and deep relationships across stakeholders (e.g., technical decision makers, business decision makers) through an understanding of customer needs and technologies.


**Leading with Technical Intensity \-** 
 Being the trusted technical advisor to the customer, prioritizing technical skills growth aligned with our cloud strategy, and infusing technical insight into helping the customer make the right business decisions.
   

  

* Architecture Design \- The ability to apply reference architecture and patterns for a variety of solutions (e.g., advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, big data, Internet of Things, modern business intelligence and analytics, modern applications, data platform modernization, data warehousing, business intelligence and analytics, etc.).
* Security Solutions \- Knowledge of security concepts and relevant Microsoft solutions (e.g., Azure Active Directory, Multi\-Factor Authentication).
* Technical Solution Development \- Knowledge of the process of developing technical solutions and ability to design, customize, or reapply technical solutions based on customer/partner needs or demands.
* Technology Industry Knowledge \- Knowledge of trends, direction, new products, and changes in the technology as it applies to a particular area of focus, as well as specific knowledge about hardware, software, and services.


**Understanding the Business \-** 
 Having a firm grasp of the Microsoft strategy, consumption, and support and connecting that to customer outcomes, using data to find new opportunities and demonstrate customer success, and leverage internal systems to accurately capture the state of the customer.
   

  

* Operational Excellence \- The ability to apply principles, systems, tools, and strategic insights to sustainably improve key performance metrics (KPIs) and drive operational efficiencies.
* Opportunity Identification \- The ability to understand customer needs and identify opportunities for additional products and services.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
 **requesting accommodations.**

371c2891.title: Software Architect
371c2891.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.
   

  

 Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Software Architect to design and guide the development of cloud\-native, scalable, and resilient microservices. The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, and modern data platforms, and will play a critical role in setting the technical direction and architecture strategy for backend systems.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect end\-to\-end solutions for cloud\-native applications with a strong focus on scalability, availability, performance, and security
* Design and oversee the development of microservices architectures, ensuring clean service boundaries, loose coupling, and high maintainability
* Define and guide the adoption of message queueing and streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Redis Streams, RabbitMQ) for event\-driven communication and real\-time processing
* Architect and optimize data storage solutions, including distributed databases (e.g., Citus, PostgreSQL, Snowflake) to meet high availability and scalability requirements
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define architecture blueprints, reference implementations, and technical standards
* Perform architecture reviews, provide hands\-on technical guidance, and ensure adherence to best practices in code quality, testing, observability, and security
* Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and tools; recommend and drive technology adoption aligned with long\-term architectural goals
* Work closely with DevOps, SRE, and security teams to ensure efficient CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and secure system design
* Provide architectural support for customer\-facing issues, performance bottlenecks, and production incidents
* Advocate for domain\-driven design (DDD), API\-first design, and event\-driven patterns across the engineering organization


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in software development, with 3\+ years as a Software Architect or in a similar architectural leadership role
* Proven experience in designing and deploying cloud\-native applications using AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Strong knowledge of microservices patterns, REST/gRPC APIs, and asynchronous communication
* Hands\-on experience with streaming and messaging platforms such as Apache Kafka, Redis Streams, RabbitMQ, or Amazon Kinesis
* Expertise in distributed databases like Citus, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, or similar
* Solid understanding of containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Helm)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, including infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK stack
* Strong focus on scalability, performance tuning, reliability, and security best practices in architecture


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
* Experience with event sourcing, CQRS, or real\-time data processing architectures
* Familiarity with data pipelines, ETL workflows, and big data platforms
* .net experience.
* Understanding of multi\-tenant SaaS architectures and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, SOC2\)
* Prior experience with technical mentoring, code reviews, and engineering process improvements


**Why Five9**
 At Five9, we believe that technology is only as powerful as the people behind it. You’ll be part of a team that values collaboration, innovation, and accountability, and you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how global enterprises engage with their customers.
   

  

 Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

 View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9\.com/pt\-pt/legal.
   

  

 Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9\.

 But what we think makes us different is ‘Team Claranet,’ our dedicated internal part of the business that supports you with matters close to your heart.
 



  





**Our Vision**




 Our vision is to become the most trusted technology solutions partner; renowned for being the best and brightest, having lasting impact with our customers and delivering exceptional returns to our stakeholders.
 



  





**Position Summary**




 The Sr. Security Consultant (Cloud Security) has responsibility for everything from client projects to development work and training, dealing with large corporate penetration testing. With a focus on large\-scale corporate penetration testing, this role demands both technical excellence and strong client engagement skills. The consultant is passionate about uncovering vulnerabilities and translating findings into actionable improvements, while building strong relationships through clear communication and exceptional customer service.
 



  





 Our team is growing, and we need inspiring people to join us and help us to continue to build a world leading cyber security operation whilst benefiting from the opportunity to fulfil their potential.
 



  





 Based in India, this work will lead on penetration testing and have the opportunity to work on projects with worldwide clients and will form part of our global team of penetration testers who share research, tooling, experience and collaborate freely on projects.
 



  





 As a respected training provider and the leading provider of training at Black Hat conferences, our penetration testers also have the option of developing training skills and delivering security training, to both private customers, at our own events, and at leading international conferences.
 



  





**Objectives \& Key Results**




 The Sr. Security Consultant (Cloud Security) is part of the Consultancy Team and represents a trusted advisor and subject matter expert in cybersecurity.
 



 The key objectives will be to:
 


* Develop the Cloud Security training content emphasizing mainly Azure/AWS/GCP
* Deliver high\-quality penetration testing and configuration reviews across various cloud technologies such as AWS/Azure/GCP
* Provide expert guidance and recommendations to clients for improving their security posture
* Mentor and support junior consultants, helping to grow the team’s overall capabilities



  





**Essential Roles \& Responsibilities**



* Develop standard operating procedures and conduct comprehensive training sessions for each technology, ensuring a thorough understanding and adherence to best practices
* A candidate should be willing to deliver the Cloud Security training in various conference remotely or on\-site
* Conduct research and provide new ideas of the training content, as per the market or latest vulnerabilities or misconfigurations
* Creating comprehensive training materials, including presentations, labs, and documentation
* Staying updated with the latest trends and developments in cloud security
* Customizing content to align with industry best practices and specific client needs
* Continuously improving and expanding training resources
* Perform cloud penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities or misconfiguration in the client environment
* Develop documentation, and a knowledge base to be used by penetration tester to conduct review, security assessments
* Develop and implement the security solution for the current cloud deployment NSS has
* Develop standard operating procedures and training for each technology
* Architect and continuously improve security technology stack, process and procedures, support model and cross\-function interactions utilizing automation where possible
* Develop and report Cloud security coverage metrics
* Define procedures to validate the effectiveness of the design, deployment, and management of security controls that aim to maintain confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Cloud networks and technology platforms
* Conduct research to stay up to date with the latest advancements in generative AI, machine learning, and deep learning techniques and identify opportunities to integrate them into our products and services
* Conduct thorough reviews and assessments of the utilization of Cloud security tooling, ensuring optimal performance and alignment with security objectives



  





**Additional Requirements:**



* Conduct comprehensive penetration tests on various systems, applications, and networks to identify vulnerabilities and weaknesses
* Prepare detailed reports of findings, including risk assessments and remediation recommendations, tailored to technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Stay updated with the latest cybersecurity threats and trends and apply this knowledge to enhance testing methodologies

**Position Specifications**




**Key Skills \& Requirements**



* A bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, International Security Architecture, or related field; or equivalent work experience in a converged security program
* 4\-7 years of hands\-on experience, preferably with at least one major cloud provider such as GCP, Azure, or AWS

* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with an ability to explain complex topics in a clear and concise manner to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Basics to intermediate development and scripting skills in at least one programming language

**Experience Requirement:**

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong architectural thinking with pragmatic execution mindset

* Excellent communication skills to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders

**What Working At EY Offers**

**EY \| Building a better working world**

2d5555c1.title: Presales Specialist
2d5555c1.description:
**Role Title:** 
 Pre Sales Specialist
 



**Role Vertical:** 
 Conversational AI 
 



**Years of Experience:** 
 5\-8 years
 



**Base Location:** 
 Noida
 



**Preferred Industry:** 
 Conversational AI, enterprise chatbots, Contact Center Automation, CPaaS, SaaS or customer\-experience platforms
 



**Minimum Qualification:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline. An MBA would be an advantage.
 



  





**About Fonada** 




 Fonada is an enterprise communication and customer\-engagement company offering CPaaS, cloud telephony, messaging and AI\-powered communication solutions.
 



 Through Fonada and FonadaLabs, we are building advanced Conversational AI solutions—including AI chatbots, voice bots, speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech, multilingual AI, voice cloning and speech analytics. These solutions help enterprises automate customer support, lead qualification, sales outreach, appointment booking, collections, onboarding and other high\-volume customer interactions.
 



**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Pre\-Sales Specialist – Conversational AI who can understand enterprise customer requirements and translate them into technically viable and commercially compelling solutions.
 



 The incumbent will work closely with Sales, Product, AI/ML, Engineering, Project Management and Customer Success teams. The role will cover customer discovery, solution design, demonstrations, proposal preparation, RFP responses, effort estimation, proof\-of\-concept execution and technical closure of sales opportunities.
 



 The position requires business understanding, consultative selling ability, Conversational AI knowledge and sufficient technical depth to engage confidently with business leaders, CIOs, CTOs, contact\-centre heads and IT teams.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Customer Discovery and Requirement Analysis** 



* Participate in customer meetings to understand business objectives, processes, pain points and automation opportunities.
* Identify use cases suitable for AI chatbots, voice bots or integrated omnichannel solutions.
* Understand conversation volumes, languages, channels, integrations, security requirements and expected business outcomes.
* Conduct discovery workshops with business, operations, contact\-centre and technology stakeholders.
* Prepare requirement documents, process flows, use\-case summaries and solution scope documents.
* Differentiate between standard, configurable and custom\-development requirements.



**Solution Design** 



* Design end\-to\-end chatbot and voice\-bot solutions aligned with customer requirements.
* Map conversation journeys, intents, entities, prompts, knowledge sources, escalation rules, exception paths and human\-agent handovers.
* Recommend the appropriate combination of rule\-based workflows, NLP/NLU, generative AI, RAG and API\-driven automation.
* Design solutions for websites, mobile applications, WhatsApp, RCS and other customer\-engagement channels.
* Incorporate FonadaLabs’ speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech, multilingual AI, speech analytics and related capabilities where relevant.
* Define integrations with CRM, ERP, contact\-centre, ticketing, payment, database and knowledge\-management platforms.
* Prepare high\-level solution architecture, data\-flow diagrams and API requirements.



**Demonstrations and Presentations** 



* Deliver product demonstrations tailored to the customer’s industry and business requirements.
* Configure demonstration bots, conversation journeys and sample knowledge bases.
* Present Fonada’s Conversational AI capabilities to business and technical stakeholders.
* Explain solution capabilities, limitations, implementation requirements and business benefits clearly.
* Develop industry\-specific use cases for sectors such as BFSI, healthcare, education, real estate, e\-commerce, travel and logistics.
* Support sales teams during customer presentations, workshops and industry events.



**Proposals, RFPs and Commercial Support** 



* Prepare technical proposals, statements of work, solution notes and implementation plans.
* Lead responses to RFPs, RFIs and technical questionnaires.
* Clearly define scope, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, deliverables and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering teams to estimate effort, timelines and resources.
* Support pricing based on conversations, users, channels, API usage, integrations and development effort.
* Build ROI\-based business cases covering cost reduction, agent productivity, conversion improvement and customer experience.
* Identify delivery, technical and commercial risks before commitments are made.



**Proof of Concept and Technical Closure** 



* Define POC scope, success criteria, timelines and responsibilities.
* Coordinate with Product, AI/ML and Engineering teams for POC delivery.
* Analyse POC results and present recommendations to customer stakeholders.
* Address technical objections, integration questions and information\-security requirements.
* Drive opportunities towards technical closure and commercial conversion.



**Sales\-to\-Delivery Handover** 



* Ensure that the solution sold is clearly documented and practically deliverable.
* Conduct detailed handovers to Project Management, Implementation and Customer Success teams.
* Transfer all agreed requirements, integrations, assumptions, exclusions and acceptance criteria.
* Support the implementation team in resolving requirement\-related issues during the initial deployment stage.
* Minimise gaps between pre\-sales commitments and final delivery.



**Product and Sales Enablement** 



* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams based on customer needs and market trends.
* Track developments in Conversational AI, generative AI, LLMs, agentic AI and contact\-centre automation.
* Monitor competing platforms and contribute to Fonada’s competitive positioning.
* Create reusable discovery questionnaires, proposals, architecture diagrams, industry solutions and demonstration scripts.
* Train the sales team on use cases, product capabilities, qualification criteria and competitive differentiation.



**Required Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline. An MBA would be an advantage.
* 5–8 years of overall experience, including at least 3 years in pre\-sales, solution consulting, product consulting or solution architecture.
* Experience with Conversational AI, enterprise chatbots, contact\-centre automation, CPaaS, SaaS or customer\-experience platforms.
* Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience preparing proposals, RFP responses, statements of work and technical presentations.
* Experience delivering enterprise product demonstrations and managing POCs.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs and enterprise integrations.
* Understanding of CRM, ERP, ticketing, contact\-centre and knowledge\-management systems.
* Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, NLP/NLU, intents, entities and conversational design.
* Basic understanding of cloud architecture, authentication, data security and enterprise deployment models.

bfb3a89e.title: Digital Solution Area Specialist
bfb3a89e.description:
**Overview**
 Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential and excitement for the journey ahead.
   

  

 In the AI Workforce Specialists team, we are looking for passionate, experienced, and credible specialist sellers with a drive for developing and winning strategic opportunities that deliver end\-to\-end AI Workforce transformation at scale through high\-impact, value\-driven customer engagements, helping organizations achieve meaningful business outcomes and unlock the full potential of AI\-powered productivity.

Success in this role comes from curiosity, learning agility, collaboration, and a growth mindset. You will be supported through formal training, certifications, mentoring, and real\-world customer engagements that progressively build your confidence and capability in consultative selling, AI workforce transformation, and customer success.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive AI Workforce transformation by leading consultative customer engagements across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot Chat, Agents, Microsoft 365 E3, Microsoft 365 E5, and Frontline Worker solutions.
* Foster relationships with Customer Business Decision Makers (BDMs) and key stakeholders, identifying and qualifying opportunities by understanding customer business priorities, technology strategies, governance models, and decision\-making processes.

* Lead consultative conversations, solution demonstrations, workshops, and customer engagements that help organizations envision, adopt, and scale AI\-powered productivity solutions.
* Orchestrate end\-to\-end AI Workforce opportunities by collaborating with internal stakeholders, customer success teams, services organizations, and partners to drive successful customer outcomes and accelerate cross\-sell and up\-sell opportunities.
* Own the performance of an assigned territory, including strategic account planning, forecasting, pipeline management, competitive positioning, and execution of intentional selling strategies aligned with Microsoft's AI priorities.
* Drive customer satisfaction and long\-term business value by supporting adoption and value realization, addressing risks, sharing industry insights and best practices, and continuously developing expertise in AI Workforce solutions and consultative selling.


**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology or a related field, AND 1\-2 years of technology\-related sales or account management experience

097fac2c.title: Architect
097fac2c.company: La Dylunio Empresa POC Pvt. Ltd.
097fac2c.description:
Architect – Design \& Execution Lead

**Location:** Canacona, South Goa  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time, In\-house  
**Work Environment:** Office \+ Active Project Sites  
**Relocation:** Mandatory

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, hands\-on Architect to join our in\-house design and execution team in South Goa.

This is not a conventional architecture\-office role.

You will work closely with the Founder on multiple hospitality, residential, landscape and experimental construction projects across South Goa, converting ideas and concepts into practical, buildable and visually distinctive spaces.

The role requires someone who enjoys being equally comfortable with a sketchbook, CAD drawings, materials, contractors, fabricators and active construction sites.

We are particularly interested in architects who want to experiment with sustainable construction, alternative materials, modular systems and unconventional architectural ideas.

You should be someone who wants to **build**, not merely design.

Key ResponsibilitiesDesign \& Concept Development

* Work directly with the Founder to develop architectural concepts and spatial ideas.
* Translate sketches, references and conceptual ideas into practical architectural solutions.
* Prepare plans, elevations, sections, details and working drawings.
* Develop design options based on site conditions, budgets and execution constraints.
* Participate in master planning, architectural planning, interiors, landscape integration and site development.
* Develop designs that respond intelligently to the tropical and coastal conditions of Goa.

Design Development \& Technical Coordination

* Convert concepts into detailed, construction\-ready drawings.
* Coordinate with the Structural Engineer, CAD/BIM team, MEP consultants and site teams.
* Resolve architectural and structural coordination issues before execution.
* Prepare and review construction details, junctions, sections and material specifications.
* Maintain proper drawing revisions and ensure the site is always working with current drawings.
* Assist in preparing as\-built drawings and documentation.

Site Execution

A significant portion of this role will be site\-based.

You will be expected to:

* Regularly visit and supervise project sites.
* Explain architectural intent and drawings to contractors and workers.
* Resolve design and execution issues directly on site.
* Coordinate with contractors, carpenters, welders, plumbers, electricians, fabricators and other trades.
* Check dimensions, levels, finishes and construction quality.
* Ensure the final execution remains faithful to the design.
* Identify problems early and develop practical solutions rather than allowing work to stop unnecessarily.
* Take ownership of projects from concept through execution.

Material Research \& Innovation

We actively experiment with materials and construction techniques.

The Architect will be expected to research and explore:

* Bamboo
* Engineered timber
* FRP and composite materials
* Structural steel
* Modular construction
* Container\-based architecture
* Lightweight structures
* Natural and biodegradable materials
* Reclaimed materials
* Local stone and laterite
* Alternative roofing and façade systems
* Coastal and corrosion\-resistant construction techniques

You do not need to already be an expert in every material.

You do need to have the curiosity and technical discipline to learn.

Vendor \& Contractor Coordination

* Identify and coordinate with specialist vendors and fabricators.
* Obtain technical information and samples.
* Compare materials, systems and execution methods.
* Assist with quotations and material selection.
* Coordinate mock\-ups and prototypes where required.
* Work closely with procurement and site teams.

What We Are Looking ForQualification

* Bachelor's Degree in Architecture (B.Arch) or equivalent recognised qualification.
* COA registration preferred.

Experience

Ideally 3**–7 years of practical architectural experience**.

Exceptional younger candidates with strong portfolios and substantial site exposure may also be considered.

Technical Skills

Strong working knowledge of:

* AutoCAD
* SketchUp

Experience with one or more of the following will be strongly preferred:

* Revit
* Rhino
* Lumion
* Enscape
* Twinmotion
* V\-Ray
* BIM workflows

You should be capable of independently developing architectural drawings rather than depending entirely on a draughtsman.

The Person We Want

We are looking for someone who:

* Is genuinely passionate about architecture and construction.
* Wants to create extraordinary work rather than repetitive commercial projects.
* Is comfortable working on active construction sites.
* Can communicate effectively with workers, contractors and specialist consultants.
* Has strong attention to detail.
* Thinks practically about how something will actually be built.
* Enjoys experimentation and problem\-solving.
* Is curious about new materials and technologies.
* Is comfortable challenging conventional construction methods where better solutions exist.
* Can take ownership rather than waiting continuously for instructions.
* Can work in a fast\-moving entrepreneurial environment.
* Is comfortable working directly with the Founder.
* Is ambitious and wants substantially greater responsibility over time.

We particularly value people whose first response to an unusual architectural challenge is:

**"Let's figure out how to build it."**

rather than:

**"This is not normally done."**

Career Opportunity

This role is intended to become much larger than that of a conventional project architect.

The right person will have the opportunity to gradually take responsibility for the organisation's **Design \& Architecture Vertical**, working across multiple projects and building an in\-house architecture, engineering and execution capability.

You will work alongside:

* Structural Engineers
* CAD/BIM Designers
* Skilled trades
* Contractors
* Fabricators
* MEP specialists
* Material suppliersThe objective is to create a highly capable internal team that can take projects from:

**Idea → Design → Engineering → Drawings → Procurement → Construction → Completion**

Location \& Mobility

The position is based in **Canacona, South Goa**.

Our projects are currently located across areas including:

* Agonda
* Cabo de Rama
* Talpona
* Other locations across South Goa

Regular travel between project sites will be required.

Candidates should ideally have their **own two\-wheeler or vehicle** for local travel.

Candidates currently living outside South Goa must be willing to **relocate to Canacona**.

This Role May Not Be For You If

* You are looking primarily for a desk\-based architectural position.
* You prefer only conceptual design and do not enjoy execution.
* You are uncomfortable dealing directly with contractors and workers.
* You require highly defined boundaries around your responsibilities.
* You are uncomfortable with experimentation or unconventional construction.
* You prefer repetitive residential/commercial drafting over solving new design problems.

This Role Could Be For You If

You want to look back five years from now and point to buildings, structures and spaces across South Goa and say:

**"I helped imagine that, engineer it, draw it and actually build it."**

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

ServiceNow Architecture, Stakeholder Management, ServiceNow Solutions, GBS

412a3d75.title: Sr AI/ML Solutions Architect
412a3d75.description:
**8\+ years total, 5\+ years hands\-on GenAI/ML \| Bangalore** 



 The role
 
 You'll own the architecture for AI/ML systems that actually run in production, not just in notebooks. That means designing the pipelines, picking the stack, getting models deployed, and keeping them healthy once they're live. You'll also be the person the team comes to when something breaks or a design call needs to be made.
 



 This is a build role. If you like being close to the code and the data, you'll fit.
 


 What you'll do
 * Architect end\-to\-end AI/ML systems in Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch and scikit\-learn. Cloud, on\-prem, or both.
* Build distributed data pipelines on Spark and Kafka for real\-time analytics and heavy ingestion.
* Ship models across classical ML, deep learning, NLP and time series forecasting using Spark MLlib, XGBoost and LightGBM. Wire them into PostgreSQL and Databricks.
* Set up deployment and monitoring with Airflow and Bash so releases are automated, not manual.
* Design and build REST API integrations so AI components talk cleanly to the rest of the enterprise stack.
* Mentor the team. Level people up on Python, R and SQL, and make sure knowledge doesn't sit with one person.
* Work directly with stakeholders to turn business asks into an architecture that holds up.


 Must have
 * Deep hands\-on AI/ML model development: classical ML, deep learning, NLP, time series.
* Strong Python. Comfortable with SQL. R and Bash for automation.
* TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, LightGBM.
* Distributed computing and data engineering: Apache Spark, Spark MLlib, Kafka, Databricks.
* PostgreSQL and MySQL in real ML workflows, not just theory.
* Track record designing secure, scalable architectures end to end.
* GenAI depth: Agentic AI, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, LLMs, vector databases.


 Good to have
 * RabbitMQ, Apache Airflow.
* Experience running or leading a small technical team.


 The details
 * **Experience:** 
 8\+ years total, 5\+ years relevant
* **Band:** 
 E3
* **Location:** 
 Bangalore. You should be open to being in office when the project needs it.
* **Type:** 
 Development project. Open to individual contributors and team leads.
* **Shift:** 
 No shift work.
