8c41d657.title: Solution Architect – Power Platform Migration (Tenant-to-Tenant)
8c41d657.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**The Role:**  

You will be the **Power Platform discipline Solution Architect** for a global tenant\-to\-tenant M365 consolidation, responsible for defining and governing the migration approach for **Power Apps, Power Automate, environments, Dataverse usage where applicable, governance controls and remediation patterns** .


Power Platform tenant moves are not “lift and shift”. The complexity sits in **connections, identity, environment strategy, DLP, ALM, solution packaging, ownership transitions, service principals and post\-move remediation** . You will design the migration blueprint, set factory runbooks and lead escalations to protect business\-critical apps and automations across waves.


**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Define the **Power Platform target\-state architecture** for the consolidated tenant: environment strategy, governance model, ALM approach, security model, connector strategy.
* Define the tenant\-to\-tenant migration approach: discovery, classification (criticality), packaging strategy (solutions), pre\-move remediation, move execution, post\-move validation and fix patterns.
* Establish runbooks and gates for: connection reference remediation, ownership transitions, environment settings alignment, DLP policy alignment and managed/unmanaged solution handling.
* Define how the factory identifies and remediates common issues: broken connections, consent issues, connector availability differences, environment variable mismatches, policy blocks.
* Coordinate dependencies with Identity/Entra Apps discipline: for consent/SSO/service principal remediation patterns, app registrations, service principals, API permissions, admin consent, conditional access.
* Define validation and acceptance criteria that are meaningful: functional smoke tests for high\-impact apps/flows, business sign\-off artefacts, rollback/recovery guidance.
* Govern exceptions and technical debt: what can be deferred, what must be fixed before cutover and what requires business acceptance of risk.
* Drive telemetry/reporting: defect categories, remediation throughput, rework rate, top blockers and continuous improvement backlog.

  

**Who You Are**

**Must‑Have:**  

* Proven delivery of **tenant\-to\-tenant Power Platform migration** in production (Power Apps \+ Power Automate) , must be demonstrated.
* Strong Power Platform architecture experience: environments, solutions, governance/DLP, security roles, connector strategy, operational support.
* Experience diagnosing and remediating migration defects at scale (connections, ownership, consent, ALM/solution issues).
* Ability to produce factory\-grade runbooks, quality gates, evidence packs and repeatable remediation patterns.
* Strong stakeholder management with app owners and business SMEs; can protect business outcomes without allowing uncontrolled exceptions.

**Good‑to‑Have:**  

* Dataverse experience (security roles, capacity considerations, integration patterns).
* Experience with PP ALM pipelines / DevOps integration.

**Interpersonal \& Consulting Skills:**  

* Can lead with clarity: sets standards, explains trade\-offs and drives compliance.
* Calm and decisive in cutover windows; can run technical war rooms and close issues fast.
* Strong coaching behaviours: turns recurring problems into standard patterns and templates.
* Communicates risk in business terms; avoids “it depends” without options and recommendations.

**Shift / Working Pattern Notes:**  

* This role operates within a **three‑shift 24x7 Factory model** . The specific rota will be confirmed, but **shift handovers are mandatory** and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

1f8720a8.title: Tech Lead – Automation Solutions (Power Platform, K2) - Husky (Guindy, Chennai)
1f8720a8.description:
At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.



Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  


**Job Description**



Are you ready to shape the next generation of enterprise automation while keeping mission\-critical workflows running smoothly?



As Tech Lead for the Automation Team, you will play a pivotal role in Husky’s transition from legacy workflow platforms to a modern, scalable automation landscape centered on the Microsoft Power Platform. You’ll lead by example—guiding your team in designing, governing, and delivering Power Apps and Power Automate solutions—while also ensuring the reliability, continuity, and evolution of existing automation solutions such as K2\.



This role sits at the intersection of innovation and responsibility: driving modernization, setting technical standards, and mentoring engineers, while safeguarding the automation backbone that supports our global business operations.



If you enjoy combining hands\-on technical leadership, platform thinking, and pragmatic enterprise automation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


**Responsibilities**


**Technical Leadership**


* Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
* Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD
* Technical direction for the product area
* Contribute to coordinating cross\-team dependencies and integration points


**Delivery \& Execution Excellence**


* Contribute to the feature definition and review
* Generate concepts and facilitate the concept selection
* Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks
* Helping with estimation and sprint planning
* Addressing technical impediments
* Own production readiness (incl. non\-functional requirements)


**Quality, Governance \& Security**


* Ensuring quality
* Conducting meaningful reviews and ensuring adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) / DoD (Definition of Done) criteria
* Ensure adherence to applicable standards, policies, and practices (e.g. DevSecOps)


**Incident Response**


* Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post\-mortems


**Mentorship \& Team Growth**


* Mentoring team members
* Documenting key design decisions
* Participate in interviews and hiring decisions
* Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams
* Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 10\+ years professional experience in software development, 5\+ years’ experience with Power Platform
* **Power Platform Expertise**
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including: Power Apps (Canvas \& Model Driven)
* Power Automate (cloud flows, approvals, error handling)
* Dataverse (data modeling, security, performance)
* Proven ability to design enterprise\-scale Power Platform solutions
* Strong understanding of solution layering, Application Lifecycle Management, and environment strategies
* **Power Platform Governance**
* Hands\-on experience implementing Power Platform governance, including DLP policies, environment strategies, Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit
* Strong understanding of: Role\-based security in Dataverse
* Tenant\-level Power Platform administration
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments (e.g., GDPR, ISO, SOC)
* **Azure \& Microsoft Ecosystem**
* Solid experience in integrating Power Platform with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Entra AD) and Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive)
* Experience with authentication and authorization: Entra AD, OAuth, service principals, managed identities
* **DevOps \& ALM**
* Proven experience with Power Platform ALM, including: Managed vs unmanaged solutions
* Versioning and deployment strategies
* **Experience with:**
* Azure DevOps or GitHub
* CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform
* Automated testing strategies (where applicable)
* Familiarity with source control best practices for low\-code assets
* **Development \& Customization Skills**
* Strong proficiency in: Power Fx
* JavaScript (for model\-driven apps)
* Understanding data modeling best practices and normalization
* Experience working with web services / APIs (e.g., SOAP, REST)
* Working knowledge of Agile development practices
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team
* Fluency in English (spoken and written)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities


**Assets**


* K2 Five / K2 BlackPearl – Workflows, Smart Objects, Forms and Views, Administration \& Troubleshooting, End\-to\-End testing
* Certifications: PL 600 \- Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
* Experience setting up or running a Power Platform Center of Excellence
* Prior experience in citizen development enablement
* Exposure to AI Builder, Copilot Studio, or Power Platform \+ AI scenarios
* Background in enterprise integration


**Why Husky?**


**Regulated Working Hours:** Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work\-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well\-being.


**Visible Impact:** Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.


**Strategic Influence:** Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape.


**Empowered Involvement:** Take an active role in decision\-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy.


**Valued Contributions:** Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services.


**Impactful Role:** Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability.


**Cutting\-Edge Projects:** Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer’s business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements.


**Supportive Community:** Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.


**Collaborative Environment:** Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success.

  

  



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

4b341837.description:
**Company Description** 
 AI Vidya is a training and career enablement organization focused on developing future leaders in artificial intelligence. The company provides personalized AI training programs designed to help individuals build practical, industry\-relevant skills. With dedicated job assistance and expert guidance, AI Vidya supports learners throughout their career journey in the digital age. The organization emphasizes confidence\-building, skill mastery, and ongoing mentorship to help participants thrive in the fast\-paced world of AI. Joining AI Vidya means being part of a community that aims to lead and innovate in the evolving AI landscape.

 We are a global technology company operating large\-scale internet platforms and cloud\-based services used by millions of customers worldwide. Our Technology Management organization provides enterprise technology governance, cybersecurity, privacy, and risk management capabilities that enable secure innovation across diverse business units and regions.
 



 Within our cybersecurity function, the Cyber Security Defense team is responsible for protecting products, infrastructure, and users against a constantly evolving threat landscape. The team combines secure engineering, threat detection, incident response, and security operations to defend critical production environments and strengthen overall cyber resilience.
 



 The Opportunity
 



 We are seeking an experienced
 **Cloud Security Detection \& Automation Engineer** 
 to design and build the detection and response capabilities that underpin our modern security operations program.
 



 This position sits at the intersection of Security Operations, Cloud Security, Detection Engineering, and Security Automation. You will be responsible for developing advanced detection content, creating security automation workflows, and building engineering solutions that improve visibility, response speed, and overall security effectiveness across a large global hybrid\-cloud environment.
 



 The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex security challenges through engineering and automation rather than manual processes and is passionate about building scalable security capabilities.
 



 What You Will Be Doing
 



 Detection Engineering
 


* Create, enhance, and optimize detection content across SIEM, EDR, and cloud security platforms.
* Develop high\-confidence detection rules that identify malicious or suspicious activity across cloud, containerized, and virtualized environments.
* Map detections to recognized threat frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Continuously improve detection coverage while minimizing false positives.



 Security Automation \& Response
 


* Design and implement security orchestration and automated response workflows (SOAR).
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to improve efficiency and reduce analyst workload.
* Develop automated remediation and containment actions for common threat scenarios.
* Improve detection\-to\-response timelines through intelligent automation.



 Cloud \& Infrastructure Security
 


* Secure and monitor hybrid cloud environments spanning public cloud and private infrastructure.
* Build automated mechanisms to assess cloud security posture and detect configuration drift.
* Strengthen security controls across Kubernetes, virtualized systems, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Support continuous compliance initiatives through automation and monitoring.

* Develop custom security tools and integrations using Python, Go, or similar technologies.
* Leverage APIs and automation frameworks to improve security visibility and operational effectiveness.
* Engineer solutions that close capability gaps within the security technology ecosystem.
* Transform security requirements into scalable, code\-driven implementations.



 Collaboration \& Threat Analysis
 


* Partner closely with SRE, DevOps, platform engineering, and infrastructure teams to embed security controls into CI/CD workflows.
* Analyze logs, telemetry, network traffic, and system activity to uncover advanced threats and suspicious behaviors.
* Contribute technical expertise during investigations and incident response activities.
* Communicate findings and technical recommendations effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



 Required Experience \& Qualifications
 


* 4\+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
* Detection Engineering
* Security Engineering
* Incident Response
* Security Operations
* Hands\-on experience securing cloud\-native, virtualized, or containerized environments.
* Practical experience with Kubernetes and at least one major cloud platform:
* AWS
* Azure
* GCP
* Strong programming ability in at least one of the following:
* Python
* Go
* Ruby
* Experience creating and maintaining detections within SIEM, EDR, or cloud security platforms.
* Demonstrated success in automating security processes through SOAR platforms or custom\-developed solutions.
* Strong understanding of:
* Network protocols
* Linux and Windows internals
* Modern web application architecture
* Ability to work effectively in a multinational environment with cross\-functional technical teams.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience building detections aligned to the MITRE ATT\&CK framework.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD technologies such as:
* Jenkins
* GitLab CI
* GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with Security\-as\-Code methodologies.
* Experience implementing identity\-centric security controls.
* Knowledge of micro\-segmentation architectures.
* Industry certifications such as:
* GCIA
* GDAT
* Comparable security certifications

 solutions for global enterprises. As a trusted Microsoft and Databricks partner, we empower some of the world's leading organizations to solve complex business challenges through innovation. You'll get the opportunity to work on impactful, enterprise\-scale projects using the latest technologies, collaborate with highly skilled professionals, and accelerate your career in a culture that values learning, ownership, and continuous growth. If you're passionate about innovation and want to build solutions that make a real\-world impact,
 **Celebal Technologies is the place to be!** 




  





  





  





**Role Summary** 




  





  





 We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to join our Databricks Practice and play a pivotal role in shaping data modernization journeys for enterprise customers. This is a customer\-facing, consulting\-oriented role where you will engage with CDOs, Data Architects, and Engineering leaders to design and deliver scalable, future\-ready Lakehouse solutions on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You will be the trusted technical advisor — translating business problems into architectural blueprints, guiding customers through EDW modernization programs, and championing the adoption of Databricks' most advanced capabilities including Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (LDP), Lakeflow Connect, Serverless Compute, Unity Catalog, and AI/BI workloads.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to join our Databricks Practice and play a pivotal role in shaping data modernization journeys for enterprise customers.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Lead pre\-sales and delivery architecture conversations with enterprise customers, owning the technical narrative from discovery through solution design and through to implementation oversight.
* Design end\-to\-end Databricks Lakehouse architectures spanning ingestion, transformation, governance, ML, and consumption layers — aligned to Medallion Architecture principles.
* Drive EDW modernization engagements, including migration strategies from legacy platforms (Teradata, Netezza, Oracle, SAS, Greenplum, Synapse, Snowflake, on\-prem Hadoop) to Databricks, with clear wave planning, risk mitigation, and TCO/ROI articulation.
* Advise customers on the adoption of advanced Databricks features
* Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (LDP / formerly DLT) for production\-grade ETL with built in data quality and lineage
* Lakeflow Connect for managed ingestion from SaaS, databases, and file sources
* Serverless Compute (SQL warehouses, jobs, notebooks) for cost and operational efficiency
* Unity Catalog for unified governance, lineage, and fine\-grained access control
* Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB) for CI/CD and environment promotion
* Expertise in Data Bulid Tool (DBT) and Databricks Autoloader
* Databricks SQL, AI/BI Dashboards, Genie for self\-service analytics
* MLflow, Model Serving, and Mosaic AI for ML and GenAI workloads
* Conduct architecture deep\-dives, PoCs, and workshops — including cost modeling, performance benchmarking, DR design, and platform sizing.
* Produce client\-ready deliverables: HLD/LLD documents, reference architectures, migration roadmaps, runbooks, and executive presentations.
* Partner with sales, delivery, and Databricks field teams to shape proposals, SoWs, and bid responses.
* Stay ahead of the Databricks product roadmap and evangelize new capabilities internally and with customers.
* Mentor data engineers, platform engineers, and junior architects on Databricks best practices.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* 8\+ years in data engineering / data platform architecture, with 3\+ years hands\-on on Databricks in a customer\-facing or consulting capacity.
* Demonstrated experience leading at least 2–3 large\-scale EDW modernization or Lakehouse migration programs end\-to\-end.
* Strong, fundamentals\-level understanding of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
* Delta Lake internals (transaction log, OPTIMIZE, Z\-ORDER, Liquid Clustering, Deletion Vectors, Predictive Optimization).
* Spark execution model, Photon, cluster sizing, and performance tuning.
* Unity Catalog object model (metastore, catalogs, schemas, volumes, external locations, storage credentials).
* Workspace, account, and identity architecture across AWS / Azure / GCP.
* Hands\-on experience designing and deploying Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Connect, and Serverless workloads in production.
* Solid grounding in Medallion Architecture, dimensional modeling, and data governance frameworks.
* Strong SQL and PySpark skills; comfort reading and reasoning about Spark execution plans.
* Cloud fluency on at least one of Azure, AWS, or GCP — including networking, IAM, and storage layers (ADLS Gen2 / S3 / GCS).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to engage equally with engineers and C\-suite.
* Willing to travel and stay overseas for Solutioning and Delivering projects.



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Databricks certifications: Certified Data Engineer Professional, Certified Machine Learning Professional, or Databricks Certified Solutions Architect Professional.
* Experience with DR architectures (Delta Deep Clone, cross\-region replication, RPO/RTO design).
* Exposure to MLOps / GenAI patterns on Databricks (MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Mosaic AI Agent Framework).
* Familiarity with legacy ETL/ELT platforms (Informatica, ODI, SAS DI, DataStage, Talend) for migration credibility.
* Experience with Terraform / Databricks Asset Bundles for IaC and CI/CD.
* Working knowledge of Immuta, Collibra, Purview, or Alation for governance integration.
* Industry depth in BFSI, Insurance, Retail, Manufacturing, or Healthcare.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





  




* Owned the architecture for at least 2 strategic customer engagements from discovery to go\-live.
* Established yourself as the go\-to advisor on advanced Databricks adoption (LDP, Lakeflow Connect, Serverless) within the practice.
* Contributed to reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and migration playbooks that scale across the practice.
* Built strong working relationships with Databricks field teams and contributed to joint pursuits.

* Prepare and maintain process flows, business process models, functional diagrams, and documentation.
* Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

* Support user adoption through training materials, user guides, and release notes.

* Understanding and relating technology integration scenarios and applying these learnings in projects

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for an InP \- IT Architect to join our ever\-evolving Enterprise Operations Team and help us unleash the potential of every business.

We are seeking an experienced **Salesforce Architect** to join our Enterprise Operations team based in **India**, supporting the enterprise\-wide implementation, integration, and optimisation of Salesforce across Enterprise (LOB). You will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, business analysts, developers, administrators, and architecture leaders to translate complex business requirements into robust Salesforce solutions. * Lead solution design activities across Salesforce capabilities including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Agentforce, and Data Cloud.

* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to developers, administrators, and junior architects.
* Contribute to architecture governance processes, standards, design patterns, and reusable frameworks.
* Support CI/CD practices and modern engineering approaches to improve delivery quality and efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging Salesforce capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that deliver business value.
* Manage technical debt and help define platform roadmaps that support long\-term business growth

**What you bring**

* Minimum 6\+ years of Salesforce experience, including significant experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale Salesforce solutions.
* Proven experience working as a Salesforce Architect, Solution Architect, or Senior Salesforce Technical Lead.
* Strong expertise across Salesforce platform capabilities including:
	+ Sales Cloud
	+ Service Cloud
	+ Experience Cloud
	+ Agentforce
	+ Data Cloud / Data 360
	+ Salesforce Platform Services
* Deep understanding of Salesforce architecture principles, platform capabilities, design patterns, and governor limits.
* Experience designing complex enterprise integrations using:
* MuleSoft
* REST APIs
* SOAP APIs
* Event\-driven architectures
* Middleware solutions

* Strong knowledge of Salesforce security architecture, including sharing models, profiles, permission sets, Shield, and compliance requirements.
* Experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Salesforce development best practices.
* Understanding of enterprise architecture concepts and technology governance frameworks.
* Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based development, and DevOps practices.
* Salesforce certifications such as:
	+ Salesforce Application Architect
	+ Salesforce System Architect
	+ Salesforce Certified Integration Architect
	+ Salesforce Development Lifecycle and Deployment Architectare highly desirable

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with the ability to balance business needs and technical constraints.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to present architectural decisions to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working within Agile and SAFe delivery environments

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

fa009481.title: Solutions Architect
fa009481.description:
**About Company** 









**At Celebal Technologies** 
 , we're shaping the future with cutting\-edge
 **AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Engineering** 
 solutions for global enterprises. As a trusted Microsoft and Databricks partner, we empower some of the world's leading organizations to solve complex business challenges through innovation. You'll get the opportunity to work on impactful, enterprise\-scale projects using the latest technologies, collaborate with highly skilled professionals, and accelerate your career in a culture that values learning, ownership, and continuous growth. If you're passionate about innovation and want to build solutions that make a real\-world impact,
 **Celebal Technologies is the place to be!** 



















**Role Summary** 














**We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to join our Databricks Practice and play a pivotal role in shaping data modernization journeys for enterprise customers. This is a customer\-facing, consulting\-oriented role where you will engage with CDOs, Data Architects, and Engineering leaders to design and deliver scalable, future\-ready Lakehouse solutions on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You will be the trusted technical advisor — translating business problems into architectural blueprints, guiding customers through EDW modernization programs, and championing the adoption of Databricks' most advanced capabilities including Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (LDP), Lakeflow Connect, Serverless Compute, Unity Catalog, and AI/BI workloads.** 














**About the Role** 














**We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to join our Databricks Practice and play a pivotal role in shaping data modernization journeys for enterprise customers.** 














**Responsibilities** 













* Lead pre\-sales and delivery architecture conversations with enterprise customers, owning the technical narrative from discovery through solution design and through to implementation oversight.
* Design end\-to\-end Databricks Lakehouse architectures spanning ingestion, transformation, governance, ML, and consumption layers — aligned to Medallion Architecture principles.
* Drive EDW modernization engagements, including migration strategies from legacy platforms (Teradata, Netezza, Oracle, SAS, Greenplum, Synapse, Snowflake, on\-prem Hadoop) to Databricks, with clear wave planning, risk mitigation, and TCO/ROI articulation.
* Advise customers on the adoption of advanced Databricks features
* Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (LDP / formerly DLT) for production\-grade ETL with built in data quality and lineage
* Lakeflow Connect for managed ingestion from SaaS, databases, and file sources
* Serverless Compute (SQL warehouses, jobs, notebooks) for cost and operational efficiency
* Unity Catalog for unified governance, lineage, and fine\-grained access control
* Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB) for CI/CD and environment promotion
* Expertise in Data Bulid Tool (DBT) and Databricks Autoloader
* Databricks SQL, AI/BI Dashboards, Genie for self\-service analytics
* MLflow, Model Serving, and Mosaic AI for ML and GenAI workloads
* Conduct architecture deep\-dives, PoCs, and workshops — including cost modeling, performance benchmarking, DR design, and platform sizing.
* Produce client\-ready deliverables: HLD/LLD documents, reference architectures, migration roadmaps, runbooks, and executive presentations.
* Partner with sales, delivery, and Databricks field teams to shape proposals, SoWs, and bid responses.
* Stay ahead of the Databricks product roadmap and evangelize new capabilities internally and with customers.
* Mentor data engineers, platform engineers, and junior architects on Databricks best practices.



  
 



  
 



**Qualifications** 













* 8\+ years in data engineering / data platform architecture, with 3\+ years hands\-on on Databricks in a customer\-facing or consulting capacity.
* Demonstrated experience leading at least 2–3 large\-scale EDW modernization or Lakehouse migration programs end\-to\-end.
* Strong, fundamentals\-level understanding of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
* Delta Lake internals (transaction log, OPTIMIZE, Z\-ORDER, Liquid Clustering, Deletion Vectors, Predictive Optimization).
* Spark execution model, Photon, cluster sizing, and performance tuning.
* Unity Catalog object model (metastore, catalogs, schemas, volumes, external locations, storage credentials).
* Workspace, account, and identity architecture across AWS / Azure / GCP.
* Hands\-on experience designing and deploying Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Connect, and Serverless workloads in production.
* Solid grounding in Medallion Architecture, dimensional modeling, and data governance frameworks.
* Strong SQL and PySpark skills; comfort reading and reasoning about Spark execution plans.
* Cloud fluency on at least one of Azure, AWS, or GCP — including networking, IAM, and storage layers (ADLS Gen2 / S3 / GCS).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to engage equally with engineers and C\-suite.
* Willing to travel and stay overseas for Solutioning and Delivering projects.



  
 



  
 



**Required Skills** 













* Databricks certifications: Certified Data Engineer Professional, Certified Machine Learning Professional, or Databricks Certified Solutions Architect Professional.
* Experience with DR architectures (Delta Deep Clone, cross\-region replication, RPO/RTO design).
* Exposure to MLOps / GenAI patterns on Databricks (MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Mosaic AI Agent Framework).
* Familiarity with legacy ETL/ELT platforms (Informatica, ODI, SAS DI, DataStage, Talend) for migration credibility.
* Experience with Terraform / Databricks Asset Bundles for IaC and CI/CD.
* Working knowledge of Immuta, Collibra, Purview, or Alation for governance integration.
* Industry depth in BFSI, Insurance, Retail, Manufacturing, or Healthcare.



  
 



  
 



**Preferred Skills** 













* Owned the architecture for at least 2 strategic customer engagements from discovery to go\-live.
* Established yourself as the go\-to advisor on advanced Databricks adoption (LDP, Lakeflow Connect, Serverless) within the practice.
* Contributed to reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and migration playbooks that scale across the practice.
* Built strong working relationships with Databricks field teams and contributed to joint pursuits.


-

**Required**

**Preferred**



* Experience with Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC, Ivanti, ManageEngine, or similar ITSM/ESM platforms.

3d0712de.title: Program Manager
3d0712de.description:
**Job Description**  

The Program Manager is accountable for planning, executing, and delivering strategic programs across multiple projects, regions, and stakeholders. The role ensures alignment with organizational objectives by driving program governance, operational efficiency, stakeholder engagement, and business value realization.

**Key Accountabilities**

**1\. Program Leadership \& Execution**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex, multi\-workstream programs.
* Define program scope, objectives, milestones, and success criteria.
* Ensure delivery against time, cost, and quality commitments.
* Monitor program performance using KPIs and dashboards.

**2\. Governance \& Compliance**

* Establish and enforce program governance frameworks (RAG status, milestones, reporting cadence).
* Ensure adherence to PMO standards, methodologies, and controls.
* Maintain documentation, decision logs, and audit readiness.

**3\. Stakeholder Management**

* Engage and influence senior stakeholders, business leaders, and clients.
* Provide clear, concise executive\-level communication and reporting.
* Manage expectations, resolve conflicts, and drive alignment.

**4\. Financial \& Resource Oversight**

* Develop and manage budgets, forecasts, and financial tracking.
* Drive cost optimization and efficiency initiatives.
* Oversee resource planning, allocation, and utilization across programs.

**5\. Risk \& Issue Management**

* Identify, assess, and mitigate program\-level risks and issues.
* Maintain RAID logs and ensure timely resolution/escalation.
* Implement mitigation and contingency strategies.

**6\. Strategic Planning**

* Translate business strategy into program roadmaps and execution plans.
* Identify dependencies and ensure cross\-functional alignment.
* Lead transformation, transition, and change management initiatives.

**7\. People Management \& Capability Building**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Project Managers and PMO resources.
* Drive performance management, coaching, and succession planning.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**8\. Process Improvement \& Innovation**

* Drive standardization and continuous improvement of PMO processes and tools.
* Promote automation, efficiency, and best practices across programs.
* Support PMO maturity and capability development initiatives.

**Certifications**

* **PMP / PRINCE2 Experience**

 **Qualifications**  

* 8–12\+ years of experience in program/project management
* Proven track record in delivering large\-scale, cross\-functional programs
* Experience working in global, matrixed organizations
* Strong exposure to stakeholder management and transformation initiatives

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and execution
* Program and portfolio management
* Financial acumen and business case development
* Risk and change management
* Stakeholder influence and negotiation
* Team leadership and coaching
* Decision\-making and problem\-solving
* Communication and presentation skills
* PM tools (MS Project, Smartsheet)
* Data analysis and reporting (Excel, Power BI)
* Governance frameworks and reporting tools
* Program delivery (on\-time, on\-budget, within scope)
* Stakeholder satisfaction and engagement
* Financial performance and cost savings
* Risk mitigation effectiveness
* Resource utilization
* PMO process compliance and adoption

  

**Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)

2cca212a.title: Solution Manager
2cca212a.description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
 We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
   

  

 We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
 **Want to be part of it?**
**Overview**
 As a Solution Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping customers and internal teams solve complex business and technology challenges. Acting as the bridge between customers, Product Management, Engineering, Delivery and Professional Services, you will lead solution discovery, shape solution approaches, and ensure successful outcomes across a portfolio of strategic initiatives.
   

  

 This role focuses on understanding business objectives, defining solution approaches, aligning stakeholders, and guiding delivery teams through complex and often cross\-functional programmes of work. You will work collaboratively across multiple domains and products, influencing decisions and driving alignment without direct management responsibility.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong business understanding, technical aptitude, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to simplify complexity into clear, deliverable solutions.
   

  

 Occasional travel may be required to support customer workshops, strategic meetings, and programme activities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Discovery \& Design**
* Lead discovery workshops and requirements gathering activities with customers and internal stakeholders
* Analyse business processes, challenges, opportunities and goals to identify the most appropriate solution approach
* Produce solution proposals, high\-level designs and recommendations that align with customer needs and business objectives
* Work closely with Product Managers, Product Owners and Engineering teams to ensure solution requirements are clearly understood and achievable
* Support definition of solution scope, assumptions, dependencies and success criteria
* Ensure solutions are scalable, supportable and aligned with architectural principles and product strategy


**Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build trusted relationships with customers, partners and internal stakeholders
* Act as a strategic adviser for complex business and technical initiatives
* Translate business requirements into clear and actionable solution outcomes
* Facilitate workshops, design reviews and solution discussions with both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Manage stakeholder expectations, priorities and competing requirements
* Communicate solution direction, risks, trade\-offs and recommendations effectively


**Solution Leadership**
* Lead solution activities across multiple teams, products and business functions
* Drive alignment between Product, Engineering, Delivery, Support and Commercial teams
* Influence decision\-making and build consensus across diverse stakeholder groups
* Provide clarity and direction when managing complex or ambiguous problems
* Ensure all parties remain aligned on solution scope, objectives and expected outcomes throughout the lifecycle of an initiative
* Act as the primary solution lead for large or strategically important programmes


**Solution Governance \& Delivery Support**
* Support programme and project teams throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Identify solution risks, dependencies, assumptions and constraints early and work with stakeholders to define mitigation plans
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned with agreed business requirements and architectural principles
* Support effort estimation, planning and solution scoping activities
* Participate in solution reviews, testing activities and implementation planning where required
* Help resolve complex delivery issues that span multiple teams or domains


**Strategy \& Innovation**
* Identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes through product adoption, process improvements and new capabilities
* Analyse customer feedback, market trends and industry developments to inform future solution direction
* Collaborate with Product Management to influence product strategy and roadmap decisions
* Support creation of business cases, proposals and strategic recommendations
* Champion best practices and continuous improvement across solution management activities


**Requirements**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration or a related discipline preferred
* Equivalent industry experience will also be considered


**Experience**
* Overall 10\+ years and 4 \- 6 years of experience in Solution Management, Solution Architecture, Product Management, Business Analysis or related technology consulting roles
* Proven experience working with complex software solutions involving multiple products, stakeholders and delivery teams
* Experience leading discovery workshops, requirements definition and solution design activities
* Experience working directly with customers and senior stakeholders
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and Agile delivery practices
* Experience operating within enterprise SaaS or digital platform environments is desirable


**Why join us?**
 We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space \- and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game\-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
   

  

**An inclusive environment to thrive**
 We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles \- not just on key days, but every day.
   

  

**Be rewarded for your efforts**
 We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
   

  

 Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
   

  

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply** 
*.*
*"

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. 9993db2e.title: Technical Account Manager
9993db2e.description:
**Technical Account Manager — Testsigma \| Bangalore** 




  





**Who We Are**




 Testsigma is building the world's first Quality Intelligence Platform — AI\-powered, agent\-driven, and designed to make software testing intelligent rather than just automated. Our platform learns your application, your history, and your domain. It doesn't just generate tests — it understands risk, detects gaps, and gives teams the confidence to release.
 



  





**What This Role Is**




 The Technical Account Manager at Testsigma is the technical backbone of the customer journey. You own the technical health of your assigned accounts — onboarding, adoption, configuration, and ongoing technical engagement — and you coordinate across internal teams to make sure the customer gets what they need.
 



 This is not a passive role. You assess each customer situation, determine what intervention is needed, and pull in the right resource. You are the one who sees the full technical picture of an account and acts on it — across SMB, mid\-market, and enterprise, in a 24x5 global environment.
 



  





**What You Will Own**




 🔹
 **Technical Onboarding** 
 — Own end\-to\-end technical onboarding from kickoff through the customer's first production test suite. You close onboarding when the customer is genuinely live, not when the tasks are done.
 



 🔹
 **Adoption \& Technical Health** 
 — Identify blockers before they become customer\-visible problems. Build account\-specific adoption plans and execute them. Monitor usage signals and act proactively.
 



 🔹
 **Technical Consulting** 
 — Lead technical calls and deep\-dives with a clear agenda. Diagnose complex environments, design the right approach, and execute it with the customer's engineering or QA team.
 



 🔹
 **Cross\-Functional Coordination** 
 — Pull in the right internal team (TSE, ES, Product) when needed — and own the follow\-through every time.
 



 🔹
 **Operational Discipline** 
 — 24\-hour follow\-up after every customer interaction. Zero accounts with lapsed status. Weekly team reviews with a prepared update.
 



  





**What You Must Have Done Before**




 ✅ 2–5 years in a TAM, Solutions Engineering, or technical customer\-facing role at a SaaS company
 



 ✅ Personally owned technical onboarding outcomes — not just completed tasks, but got customers live
 



 ✅ Can independently diagnose adoption blockers (configuration gaps, integration failures, capability gaps) without being told where to look
 



 ✅ Can read logs, API responses, and usage data and form a hypothesis
 



 ✅ Has configured or integrated a SaaS product in a real customer environment
 



 ✅ Can hold a credible technical conversation with a customer's engineering or QA team
 



 ✅ Strong written and verbal English
 



 ✅ Open to 24x5 rotational shifts
 



 ✅ B.Tech / Engineering degree or equivalent
 



  





**Strong Advantage**




 ⭐ Experience with test automation platforms or QA tooling
 



 ⭐ Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and enterprise environments
 



 ⭐ Exposure to Gainsight, Totango, or similar CS platforms
 



 ⭐ Experience across SMB through enterprise segments
 



 ⭐ Familiarity with Postman, Jira, Salesforce
 



  





**Why Testsigma**




 → Deep technical exposure across a wide range of customer environments globally (US, APAC, Europe)
 



 → Real autonomy — you own your accounts and how you manage them
 



 → Growth tracks into TAM Lead, ES Lead, or Solutions Engineering
 



 → Build the TAM function from the ground up — your input on how it works will be heard
 



 → Flat hierarchy, direct exposure to Product and Engineering
 



 → 100% company\-paid medical insurance, daily catered lunch, free snacks
 



  





**One Question to Ask Yourself**




 Have I owned the technical onboarding and adoption outcome for a customer — where I was responsible not just for the configuration, but for identifying what was blocking them, coordinating internally, and making sure they were genuinely using the product before I called it done?
 



 If yes — we should talk.
 



  





**How to Apply**




 When applying, include a specific example of a technical onboarding or adoption engagement you owned: what the biggest blocker was, how you coordinated internally to resolve it, and what the customer outcome was.
 



  





 We read every application.

974eba06.title: Principal Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
974eba06.description:
At Toku, we create bespoke cloud communications and customer engagement solutions to reimagine customer experiences for enterprises. We provide an end\-to\-end approach to help businesses overcome the complexity of digital transformation and deliver mission\-critical CX through cloud communication solutions. Toku combines local strategic consulting expertise, bespoke technology, regional in\-country infrastructure, connectivity, and global reach to serve the diverse needs of enterprises operating at scale. Headquartered in Singapore, Toku supports customers across APAC and beyond, with a growing footprint across global markets.
 



  





 This is our most senior hands\-on infrastructure engineering role, responsible for setting the technical direction, architecture, and engineering standards across our infrastructure platforms. Working alongside the VP of Infrastructure, you will lead the design and implementation of modern cloud and hybrid infrastructure, mentor engineers, and drive automation, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence. This role combines deep technical expertise with architectural leadership, helping shape the future of Toku's infrastructure estate. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges while influencing engineering standards through technical leadership rather than people management.
 



  





**What you will be doing** 




  




* **Technical architecture \& infrastructure leadership:** 
 Act as the senior technical authority for infrastructure engineering, designing scalable, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions across AWS, Azure, hybrid cloud and on\-premise environments while influencing engineering best practices across the team.
* **Cloud architecture \& implementation:** 
 Design, build and optimise cloud infrastructure platforms, selecting appropriate cloud services, architectures and deployment patterns that support engineering and business requirements while balancing scalability, reliability, security and operational simplicity.
* **AWS platform engineering:** 
 Lead the design, implementation and optimisation of AWS infrastructure, driving adoption of modern cloud services and best practices while improving the team's technical capability across the AWS ecosystem.
* **Azure platform expansion:** 
 Lead the design and secure implementation of Azure Landing Zone architecture and establish scalable Azure infrastructure foundations to support future business requirements.
* **Infrastructure as Code \& automation:** 
 Own and champion Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform and related tooling, building reusable modules, improving environment consistency, reducing configuration drift, and driving automation across development, staging, UAT and production environments.
* **CI/CD \& platform engineering:** 
 Improve deployment pipelines, release processes and infrastructure delivery standards, ensuring infrastructure changes are repeatable, auditable and consistently deployed across all environments.
* **Engineering standards \& technical governance:** 
 Establish infrastructure design standards, architecture principles, documentation standards and technical best practices, providing technical guidance and design reviews across infrastructure initiatives.
* **Mentoring \& technical leadership:** 
 Mentor cloud and infrastructure engineers through technical coaching, architectural guidance, code reviews and knowledge sharing, helping raise the overall capability and maturity of the team.
* **Reliability \& operational excellence:** 
 Improve infrastructure resilience through monitoring, observability, capacity planning, disaster recovery, high availability design, root cause analysis and continual service improvement.
* **Infrastructure security:** 
 Embed security best practices into infrastructure design, including identity and access management, infrastructure hardening, secure network design, vulnerability remediation and cloud security controls, while partnering closely with dedicated security specialists where required.
* **Hybrid infrastructure:** 
 Contribute to the design, operation and optimisation of hybrid infrastructure spanning public cloud, on\-premise environments and physical infrastructure where appropriate.
* **Technology evaluation \& optimisation:** 
 Evaluate emerging infrastructure technologies, cloud services and tooling, recommending improvements that increase operational efficiency, simplify management, reduce technical debt and optimise infrastructure cost.
* **Cross\-functional collaboration:** 
 Work closely with Engineering, Product and Infrastructure leadership to translate application requirements into robust infrastructure solutions, providing technical expertise throughout project delivery.



  





**We'd love to hear from you if you have** 




  




* **Experience level:** 
 Around 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, including significant experience designing and delivering production cloud infrastructure within complex technology environments.
* **Cloud architecture (core requirement):** 
 Deep hands\-on experience designing and implementing AWS infrastructure in production environments. Experience with Azure architecture and Landing Zone implementation would be highly advantageous.
* **AWS platform expertise:** 
 Strong practical experience across core AWS services including EC2, ECS/EKS, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront, Route53 and related networking and security services, with the ability to evaluate and implement newer AWS managed services where appropriate.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** 
 Extensive hands\-on experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform as a primary tool. Experience with CloudFormation, Pulumi or AWS CDK would be advantageous.
* **Platform engineering \& CI/CD:** 
 Strong experience designing infrastructure delivery pipelines, deployment automation and modern platform engineering practices, with practical knowledge of CI/CD tooling and multi\-environment deployment strategies.
* **Containers \& orchestration:** 
 Strong experience with Kubernetes and container platforms, particularly within cloud\-native production environments.
* **Architecture \& engineering standards:** 
 Demonstrated experience defining infrastructure architecture, establishing engineering standards, reviewing technical designs and improving technical maturity across engineering teams.
* **Automation \& scripting:** 
 Strong automation mindset with practical experience developing infrastructure automation, scripting and operational tooling.
* **Hybrid infrastructure:** 
 Experience operating across cloud, hybrid and on\-premise infrastructure environments, with exposure to networking, storage and physical infrastructure considered advantageous.
* **Infrastructure reliability:** 
 Strong experience designing highly available systems, improving observability, conducting incident investigations, performing root cause analysis, and implementing disaster recovery and resilience strategies.
* **Security awareness:** 
 Practical understanding of cloud security, infrastructure hardening, IAM, secure networking and infrastructure security best practices. Experience partnering with cybersecurity teams would be beneficial.
* **Linux \& networking:** 
 Good working knowledge of Linux systems administration and cloud networking principles. Deep specialist Linux administration is not essential, but candidates should be comfortable operating within Linux\-based environments.
* **Technical leadership:** 
 Proven ability to mentor engineers, influence technical direction, communicate architectural decisions and raise engineering standards without relying on formal people management authority.
* **Commercial awareness:** 
 Experience evaluating infrastructure technologies, balancing technical excellence with operational efficiency and cost optimisation.
* **Location:** 
 This role can be based in Bangalore – India, or KL \- Malaysia. It will operate on a mostly WFH basis for the time being, but in the future will require a hybrid WFH/WFO model.



  





 Toku has been recognised as a LinkedIn Top Startup and by the Financial Times as one of APAC's Top 500 High Growth Companies. If you're looking to be part of a company on a strong growth trajectory while working on meaningful, real\-world challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

9fdd7b6b.title: Lead - Managed Services Consultant
9fdd7b6b.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What Are Your Responsibilities**
* Ensure that every customer derives the most value possible from the platform leading to retention and business expansion.
* Identify, comprehend and clearly articulate customers' requirements to generate an end\-to\-end solution to their business challenges.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and tie them to specific Sprinklr use cases, product features, benefits and value propositions.
* Identify platform gaps, and optimization opportunities; designing and configuring the appropriate solutions so client expectations regarding platform use\-cases and functionalities are fulfilled.
* Own \& deliver the end\-to\-end configuration of solution based on the customer requirements
* You will handle the post go\-live change management of configuration throughout the customer life cycle
* Be the hands\-on product expert and ensure customer’s business goals are met
* Act as day\-to\-day contact for stakeholders in brand, agencies and for System Administrators.
* Analyse and elevate customer’s consumption of contract, adoption of the product and generation of upsell or cross\-sell.
* Provide oversight on any additional enablement of the software deployment to be in line with current architecture and future client needs or business requirements.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve operational efficiencies and find suitable entities which could benefit from utilising AI to drive greater ROI.
* Establish and nurture senior level relationships built on trust, develop client champions and identify key stakeholders.
* Capture development areas for product improvement and collaborate with product managers and engineering for necessary corrective actions.
* Actively make sure you are knowledgeable on native channel’s products package.
* Work with clients to improve the social service itself and its alignment with the client's core business.
* Provide on\-going training support and ad hoc training sessions to always keep customers educated on Sprinklr’s know\-hows.
* Identify opportunities for customer references and case studies.
* Maintain platform relevancy according to changes in business needs.


- 

**Who You Are \& What Makes You Qualified**
**Must Have Qualifications:**
* 8\+ years of experience in managed services or technology consulting, specifically in the CCaaS or cloud contact center industry.
* Strong knowledge of CCaaS technologies, including IVR, call routing, AI integrations, and customer journey management.
* Experience with cloud communication platforms, AI\-driven customer support solutions, Chatbots and integrating CCaaS with third\-party applications.
* Familiarity with CCaaS platforms like Genesys, Cisco Webex Contact Center, Twilio Flex, or other related technologies.
* Understanding of cloud architecture, VoIP, SIP, and telephony.
* Hands\-on experience with system configuration, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work closely with clients and internal teams.
* Proven ability to understand business challenges and provide actionable recommendations.
* Ability to manage multiple client engagements and deliver high\-quality service.
* Ability to translate customer business problems \& requirements into on platform solutions


**Good to Have Skills:**
* Demonstrated experience and a passion for the social technology universe (i.e., Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat, TikTok).
* Direct experience in working with a social media management software is preferred.
* Strong product acumen \& evangelization experience with the aptitude to learn new products.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Multilingual skills (French, German, Spanish, Japanese or others) would be a plus.
* Analytical mind\-set with attention to detail along with excellent problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills.
* Leading CCaaS Certifications like Genesys Cloud CX Professional, Cisco Certified Professional, Avaya Certified IC are preferred (not mandatory)


**Who You Are**
 You are a technology consultant who has the:
   

  

* Ability to think independently and learn as a member of a team.
* Ability to identify and clearly articulate issues clients are facing and capability of devising \& implementing their solutions.
* Ability to work in a highly challenging \& competitive environment while delivering high quality of customer service.
* Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines and juggle several assignments \& projects simultaneously, while maintaining high standard of excellence.
* Intrinsically motivated to tackle unique client use cases, passion to solve business challenges and commitment to client delight.
* Ability to interpret industry trends across different verticals \& lines of businesses.
* Ability to operate in an autonomous way, engage with stakeholders across the globe and lead customers through change management.


**You Know You're Successful If**
* The depth, breadth and frequency of customer platform adoption starts strong and keeps climbing.
* Your customers acknowledge Sprinklr value, renew their product offerings \& add new licences, modules and services to their package.
* You constantly come up with new strategies that are adopted by your clients and peers.
* Your stakeholders participate in Sprinklr events, references and case studies.
* Your platform and industry knowledge makes you a trusted advisor both internally and externally.


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**Why You'll Love Sprinklr:**
 We're committed to creating a culture where you feel like you belong, are happier today than you were yesterday, and your contributions matter. At Sprinklr, we passionately, genuinely care. For full\-time employees, we provide a range of comprehensive health plans, leading well\-being programs, and financial protection for you and your family through a range of global and localized plans throughout the world.
   

  

 For more information on Sprinklr Benefits around the world, head to https://sprinklrbenefits.com/ to browse our country\-specific benefits guides.
   

  

**We focus on our mission:** 
 We founded Sprinklr with one mission: to enable every organization on the planet to make their customers happier. Our vision is to be the world’s most loved enterprise software company, ever.
   

  

 We believe in our product: Sprinklr was built from the ground up to enable a brand’s digital transformation. Its platform provides every customer\-facing team with the ability to reach, engage, and listen to customers around the world. At Sprinklr, we have many of the world's largest brands as our clients, and our employees have the opportunity to work closely alongside them.
   

  

**We invest in our people:** 
 At Sprinklr, we believe every human has the potential to be amazing. We empower each Sprinklrite in the journey toward achieving their personal and professional best. For wellbeing, this includes daily meditation breaks and virtual fitness. We have continuous learning opportunities available with LinkedIn Learning and more.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

Manages multiple projects collaboratively. Works with HR in recruitment and performance appraisal process. Mentor the team members and layout their growth path.**Role Summary**


Leads the execution and operationalization of enterprise AI initiatives, ensuring AI strategy is translated into scalable, business\-impacting solutions. Partners across business and technology teams to drive delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes, while maintaining strong alignment to enterprise priorities and governance. Acts as a senior program leader with end\-to\-end accountability for execution, value realization, and executive alignment across priority AI initiatives

**1\) Enterprise AI Execution \& Operationalization:** Translate enterprise AI strategy into actionable roadmaps, delivery plans, and implementation milestones**.** Drive end\-to\-end execution of priority AI initiatives across multiple business areas. Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. Own delivery outcomes across initiatives, including scope, timelines, and measurable business impact.

**2\) Program \& Portfolio Delivery:** Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Establish and manage delivery discipline (prioritization, dependencies, timelines, risk mitigation). Ensure outcomes are tied to clear business value (e.g., productivity, growth, cost, risk). Drive integrated program plans, track KPIs and milestones, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, and execution challenges, escalating as needed.

Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and translate into practical application.

**5\) Adoption, Change \& Value Realization:** Drive business adoption of AI solutions, not just delivery. Define metrics and success measures and track realization of expected outcomes.
