afa5ff3c.title: Finance Service Delivery Manager
afa5ff3c.description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.



A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."



* Location
Bengaluru
* Employment type
Full Time Permanent
* Department
Finance, Accounting \& Tax
* Deadline
2026\-08\-10

  
Candidate profile (title) Who you are
Candidate profile (text) \- Default language You are an experienced Finance Operations leader with a passion for delivering high\-quality services, driving operational excellence and developing high\-performing teams.
  

You bring strong expertise in end\-to\-end Finance processes, particularly within the Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) domain and have a proven track record of leading service delivery within shared services, global business services (GBS) or multinational organizations.
  

You know how to balance operational performance with stakeholder expectations and are comfortable navigating complex environments involving multiple countries, functions and external service providers.
  

You are a strong relationship builder who can influence across organizational boundaries and drive sustainable improvements through collaboration, data\-driven decision making and a customer\-focused mindset.
  

You are passionate about developing people, improving ways of working and creating value through service excellence.
  

Like us, you are inspired by creating a better everyday life for the many people and believe in doing business with people and the planet at heart.
  

  

What we're looking for
  

  

* University degree and at least 3 years of related experience, or a minimum of 6 years of relevant professional experience.
* Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing Finance Operations, Service Delivery teams, Shared Services or Global Business Services organizations.
* Proven experience leading teams of significant scale within transactional finance environments.
* Strong practical experience within Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) processes, including Accounts Receivable, Credit Management, Collections, Cash Application, Sales Reconciliation or similar finance operations.
* Comprehensive knowledge of end\-to\-end Finance processes, service performance management, operational controls, SLAs and KPIs.
* Demonstrated experience managing service delivery through outsourced service providers, BPO partners and delivery centers.
* Experience governing vendor performance through service reviews, contractual SLAs, KPI management, escalation handling and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with experience leading root cause analysis and implementing sustainable solutions.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and leadership capabilities.
* Fluent English and proven experience working within a global and matrixed business environment.

  

Ideal candidate
  

  

The ideal candidate is an experienced Finance Operations or Service Delivery leader with a strong background in O2C processes and outsourced service delivery. You have successfully led large transactional finance teams, partnered with external providers and driven improvements in service quality, operational performance and customer experience in a multinational environment.
Key responsibilities (title) A day in your life with us
Key responsibilities (text) Every day is an opportunity to ensure stable, efficient and high\-quality Finance service delivery across our global operations.
  

You will:
  

* Oversee Finance service delivery across internal operations teams and outsourced partners, ensuring agreed SLAs, KPIs, controls and service commitments are consistently achieved.
* Monitor operational performance, identify risks, performance gaps and improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions to secure service stability.
* Act as the key link between Finance Service Managers, Finance Experts, operational teams, markets and outsourced service providers to ensure seamless end\-to\-end process execution.
* Lead vendor governance activities, including service reviews, performance management, escalation handling and continuous improvement planning.
* Drive issue resolution and root cause analysis.
* Implement solutions that improve service quality, compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement across teams and partners.
* Identify and implement opportunities to simplify processes, increase automation and improve user and customer experience.
* Lead and develop Team Leaders and Finance Experts, building organizational capability and future leadership strength.
* Ensure Finance services are delivered with a focus on efficiency, effectiveness and exceptional stakeholder experience.
Team vision ( title) Together as a team
Team vision (text) Within Global Business Operations (GBO), we deliver Finance services that enable IKEA markets to operate efficiently and grow sustainably. Inspired by collaboration and operational excellence, we partner closely with countries, Finance Service Managers, Finance Experts and external service providers to create stable and effective end\-to\-end Finance services.
  

Together, we simplify ways of working, increase automation, improve service quality and drive continuous improvement across our global Finance organization.
  

As a Finance Service Delivery Manager, you will play a critical role in shaping the future of Finance operations by leading people, driving service performance and ensuring excellence across our Order\-to\-Cash and Finance service delivery landscape.
### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home\-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.  

  

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co\-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.  

  

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.
### **What we all have in common**


* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing \& delivering while learning \& developing
* Having fun!

You will lead the successful adoption of Google Cloud at leading organizations, guiding them through the strategic and technical facets of their Cloud transformation journey. e200305d.title: Technical Program Manager - Release Management
e200305d.description:
DataHub is an AI \& Data Context Platform adopted by over 3,000 enterprises, including Apple, CVS Health, Netflix, and Visa. Innovated jointly with a thriving open\-source community of 13,000\+ members, DataHub's metadata graph provides in\-depth context of AI and data assets with best\-in\-class scalability and extensibility.
   

  

 The company's enterprise SaaS offering, DataHub Cloud, delivers a fully managed solution with AI\-powered discovery, observability, and governance capabilities. Organizations rely on DataHub solutions to accelerate time\-to\-value from their data investments, ensure AI system reliability, and implement unified governance, enabling AI \& data to work together and bring order to data chaos.
   

  

****What you’ll do:****
* Manage end\-to\-end release cadences for both DataHub Core (OSS) and our Managed Cloud
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including engineering, product, QA, DevOps, documentation, and customer success
* Define Quality Gates: Establish the "Go/No\-Go" criteria that ensure every release is rock\-solid
* Build Automation: Design the dashboards and runbooks that turn manual release chaos into a streamlined machine
* Risk Mitigation: Identify breaking changes and dependency conflicts before they hit production
* Serve as the central point of contact for all release\-related questions and updates
* Facilitate release retrospectives and drive continuous improvement initiatives


****Required Qualifications****
* 5\+ years of experience in technical program management or release management roles
* Proven track record of managing complex software releases in fast\-paced startup environments
* Deep understanding of software development lifecycles, CI/CD practices, and DevOps principles
* Experience with both open\-source and enterprise software release models is a strong plus
* Strong technical background with ability to understand architecture, dependencies, and technical trade\-offs
* Excellent project management skills with proficiency in tools like Jira, Linear, or similar
* Outstanding communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts for diverse audiences
* Experience working with cross timezone \& cross\-functional teams


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with data platforms, metadata management, or data catalog platforms is a strong plus
* Background in managing releases for platforms with complex architectures
* Experience with GitHub workflows, release automation, and version management
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud\-native deployment models
* Previous involvement in open\-source communities and understanding of OSS governance
* Knowledge of SaaS operations, single tenant \& multi\-tenant architectures, and staged rollout strategies
* Familiarity with observability tools, incident management, and on\-call processes
* Background in Agile/Scrum methodologies and sprint planning


****Benefits and Perks****
 We invest in people so they can do their best work and enjoy doing it. Our benefits reflect the way we build: practical, thoughtful, and designed to support long\-term growth.
   

  

**Competitive Compensation**
 We offer salaries that reflect your skills, experience, and the impact you make. You bring value—we make sure you're recognized for it.
   

  

**Equity for everyone**
 Every team member receives an ownership stake in the company. When we grow, you grow with us.
   

  

**Remote Work**
 All roles are remote unless otherwise specified in the job description. Review the job description to confirm if the role you are interested in is remote or hybrid.
   

  

**Location flexibility**
 Home office, coworking space, or something in between? We support your ideal setup. You’ll receive a monthly coworking stipend to use whenever you need a change of pace or in\-person collaboration time.
   

  

**Comprehensive health coverage**
 Your well\-being matters. We cover 99% of medical, dental, and vision premiums employees, and 65% for dependents.
   

  

**Flexible savings accounts**
 We offer FSAs to help cover planned or unexpected healthcare costs. You can also opt into a Dependent Care FSA to support family needs.
   

  

**Support for every path to parenthood**
 Through Carrot Fertility, we provide inclusive fertility benefits and family\-forming support. All U.S. employees have access, regardless of age, gender identity, or family structure.
   

  

**Time off that works for you**
 We trust you to take the time you need. Our unlimited PTO and sick leave policy is designed for flexibility, rest, and real life.
   

  

****Why Join Us****
 DataHub is at a rare inflection point: we’ve achieved product\-market fit, earned the trust of leading enterprises, and secured backing from top\-tier investors like Bessemer Venture Partners and 8VC. The context platform market is expected to grow from $1B to $9B in the next five years—and we’re leading the way.
   

  

 By joining our team, you’ll:
   

  

* Tackle high\-impact challenges at the heart of enterprise AI infrastructure
* Ship production systems that power real\-world use cases at global scale
* Collaborate with a high\-caliber team of builders who’ve scaled some of the most influential data tools in the world
* Build the next generation of AI\-native data systems, including conversational agents, intelligent classification, automated governance, and more


 If you're passionate about technology, enjoy working with customers, and want to be part of a fast\-growing company changing the industry, we want to hear from you!

**Experience**

**Job Summary:**


The Salesforce Senior Developer on the Salesforce Experience Cloud team will be a key technical contributor responsible for designing, developing, and delivering engaging, scalable digital experience solutions built on the **Salesforce Experience Cloud (formerly Community Cloud)** platform. This role partners closely with UX designers, business stakeholders, product owners, and solution architects to create intuitive, branded, and highly functional portals, communities, and self\-service experiences for customers, partners, and employees. **What You'll Do:**

* Design, build, and deploy **Salesforce Experience Cloud** solutions including customer portals, partner communities, employee hubs, and self\-service sites using **LWR (Lightning Web Runtime) and Aura\-based** templates.
* Develop custom **Lightning Web Components (LWC)** and **Aura components** tailored for Experience Cloud pages, ensuring responsiveness, accessibility (WCAG compliance), and cross\-browser compatibility.

* Implement and manage **user authentication and access control** mechanisms including guest user access, login flows, self\-registration, social sign\-on (SSO/OAuth), and community membership models.

* Develop **integrations** between Experience Cloud and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, named credentials, and platform events to deliver seamless end\-to\-end user journeys.
* Enforce **platform security best practices** including guest profile hardening, sharing rule configuration, CRUD/FLS enforcement, and OWASP\-aligned secure coding standards.
* Partner with the **DevOps team** to ensure Experience Cloud components and configurations are properly version\-controlled and deployed through CI/CD pipelines.
* Conduct **code reviews**, provide technical mentorship to junior developers, and champion Experience Cloud development best practices across the team.
* Monitor **site performance, analytics, and user engagement metrics**, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks or usability issues.
* Stay current with **Salesforce tri\-annual releases** and evaluate new Experience Cloud features (e.g., LWR enhancements, Salesforce CMS updates, Digital Experiences innovations) for team applicability.
* Create and maintain **technical documentation** including solution design documents, component libraries, site architecture diagrams, and deployment guides.
* Participate in **Agile/Scrum ceremonies** including sprint planning, stand\-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor's degree** in Computer Science, Information Technology, Web Development, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **5\+ years** of Salesforce development experience, with at least **2\+ years** of focused hands\-on experience with **Salesforce Experience Cloud (Community Cloud)**.
* Proficiency in **Lightning Web Components (LWC)**, **Aura components**, **Apex**, **SOQL**, and **declarative automation tools** (Flow, Process Builder).
* Strong experience with **Experience Builder**, including theme customization, page layouts, branding sets, and audience\-based personalization.
* Solid understanding of **Experience Cloud security model**: guest user profiles, sharing rules, community membership, login flows, and external user licensing.
* Hands\-on experience with **front\-end web technologies**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6\+) within the Salesforce platform context.
* Working knowledge of **Salesforce CMS** and content management within Experience Cloud.
* Familiarity with **SSO, OAuth 2\.0, and SAML** authentication protocols in the context of community login and registration flows.
* Experience with **Salesforce DX**, Git\-based version control, and deployment best practices.
* Active **Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I** certification.
* Experience in **Agile/Scrum** delivery environments.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Salesforce Experience Cloud Consultant**, **Platform Developer II**, or **Salesforce Application Architect** certifications.
* Hands\-on experience with **LWR (Lightning Web Runtime)** sites and **Enhanced LWR templates** for high\-performance digital experiences.
* Familiarity with **Salesforce CMS Connect** and headless CMS integrations for content\-rich experience delivery.
* Experience with **Salesforce Digital Experiences** analytics, including **CRM Analytics** dashboards embedded in community pages.
* Familiarity with **Salesforce Order Management, Service Cloud**, or **Commerce Cloud** integrations surfaced through Experience Cloud portals.
* Experience with **CDN configuration, caching strategies**, and performance optimization for high\-traffic Experience Cloud sites.
* Prior experience in **healthcare, pharmaceutical distribution, or life sciences** industries, particularly with customer or partner portal implementations (aligned with Cencora's business domain).
* Strong **UX sensibility and stakeholder communication skills**, with the ability to bridge technical implementation and digital experience strategy.
* Demonstrated experience **mentoring junior developers** and contributing to component libraries or internal developer enablement.
* Familiarity with **A/B testing, personalization strategies**, and engagement optimization within digital experience platforms.

  

.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

 Master's Degree

* Cloud Security Strategy Development: Exposure to defining business drivers and designing associated security services across domains such as risk and compliance, application, data, endpoint, and network.
* Multi\-Cloud Security Implementation: Experience working with hybrid and multi\-cloud platforms to implement comprehensive security services, addressing native and non\-native security concerns.
* Domain\-Specific Security Expertise: Exposure to developing and implementing security services across various domains, including risk and compliance, application, data, endpoint, and network.
* Technical Solution Delivery: Experience applying technical expertise to deliver cloud security solutions, collaborating with stakeholders to address unique security challenges and requirements.
* Cloud Security Best Practices: Exposure to providing expert guidance on cloud security best practices, risk management, and compliance to inform decision\-making.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Cloud Security Architecture Knowledge: Exposure to designing and implementing comprehensive security services across multiple domains, including risk and compliance, application, data, endpoint, and network, in hybrid and multi\-cloud platforms.
* Advanced Threat Protection: Experience working with cloud security solutions to address native and non\-native security concerns, including risk management and compliance.
* Cloud Security Frameworks Familiarity: Exposure to cloud security best practices, frameworks, and standards to inform decision\-making and guide clients in their cloud security posture.

1a786315.title: Program Manager 4
1a786315.description:
**Job Description**
 Principal Program Manager, OCI Transitions and Migrations
   

  

 Are you a creative problem\-solver who thrives on complex challenges? Do you enjoy bringing structure to ambiguity, aligning diverse stakeholders, and driving large\-scale programs to successful outcomes? If so, you may be the perfect fit for our team as a Principal Program Manager.
   

  

 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is transforming how organizations run their most important applications and workloads. The OCI Transitions and Migrations team helps customers plan and execute complex transitions to Oracle Cloud, coordinating activities across customer teams, engineering, operations, product management, support, sales, and other Oracle organizations.
   

  

 As a Principal Program Manager for OCI Transitions and Migrations, you will lead high\-impact migration and transition programs, establish clear execution plans, manage cross\-functional dependencies, and ensure successful delivery. You will act as a central point of accountability, communicate program status to senior leadership, and drive resolution of issues that span teams and organizations.
   

  

 Job Requirements
   

  

**8\+ Years of Related Experience:**
 Eight or more years of experience in program management, project management, cloud migrations, enterprise technology delivery, consulting, operations, or a related field.
   

  

**Program Leadership and Execution:**
 Demonstrated experience leading large, complex programs across multiple teams, workstreams, and organizational boundaries. Proven ability to develop integrated plans, roadmaps, milestones, governance models, and success measures.
   

  

**Cloud and Migration Experience:**
 Experience supporting cloud transitions, enterprise migrations, infrastructure programs, application migrations, data migrations, or technology transformation initiatives. Experience with OCI, AWS, Azure, or other enterprise cloud platforms is preferred.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Leadership:**
 Ability to build strong relationships, align stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and drive shared outcomes across engineering, operations, product, support, sales, customer, and leadership teams.
   

  

**Risk, Dependency, and Change Management:**
 Experience identifying risks, managing complex dependencies, developing mitigation and recovery plans, and maintaining progress through changing priorities or ambiguous conditions.
   

  

**Communication and Influence:**
 Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management skills. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex information clearly, influence without direct authority, and represent programs effectively with senior leaders.
   

  

**Strategic and Analytical Thinking:**
 Ability to connect program execution to broader customer and business objectives, work with large amounts of qualitative and quantitative information, assess program health, and make sound recommendations.
   

  

**Educational Background:**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Lead Program Delivery:**
 Lead complex OCI transition and migration programs from planning through execution, stabilization, and completion, ensuring delivery aligns with scope, schedule, customer commitments, and business objectives.
   

  

**Manage Roadmaps, Dependencies, and Resources:**
 Develop and maintain integrated program roadmaps, milestones, ownership models, dependencies, resource requirements, and success criteria across cross\-functional teams.
   

  

**Drive Stakeholder Alignment and Execution:**
 Establish alignment and accountability across customer teams, engineering, operations, product management, support, sales, and partner organizations. Remove barriers and drive timely decisions and actions.
   

  

**Manage Risks and Resolve Issues:**
 Identify risks, issues, and dependencies early; develop mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans; and independently drive resolution of cross\-team and division\-level challenges.
   

  

**Establish Program Governance:**
 Create and maintain effective governance, including decision\-making processes, escalation paths, status reporting, operating cadences, metrics, and executive review mechanisms.
   

  

**Communicate Program Status and Recommendations:**
 Provide clear written and verbal updates on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and customer impact. Present complex issues with relevant data, tradeoffs, options, and recommendations.
   

  

**Represent the Program With Senior Leadership:**
 Represent the program and organization independently in discussions through the VP level and support higher\-level executive engagements as appropriate.
   

  

**Maintain Customer and Operational Excellence:**
 Ensure a consistent Oracle customer experience throughout the transition and migration lifecycle while maintaining high standards for quality, readiness, and execution.
   

  

**Improve Program Practices:**
 Identify and implement improvements to planning, governance, reporting, risk management, communications, and execution. Develop reusable templates, dashboards, metrics, and best practices that improve consistency and predictability.
   

  

**Build Relationships and Mentor Others:**
 Build trusted partnerships across teams, organizations, cultures, and geographies, while providing guidance and mentorship to other program managers.
   

  

 Join Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and help customers successfully transition their most important workloads to the cloud. Your leadership, judgment, and ability to drive complex programs will play a critical role in delivering successful migration outcomes and improving how OCI executes transitions at scale.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Identifies, prioritizes, and successfully executes a broad portfolio of functional initiatives and programs. Plans and directs schedules for multiple programs running simultaneously. Partners closely with global cross\-functional teams to understand and capture requirements for programs. Navigates complex dependencies between cross\-functional teams and organizational priorities to optimize the critical path and addresses \& mitigates risks. Effectively influences internal and external teams to prioritize; Drives mitigation plans and ensures ownership for each item and regular follow up through to program closure while ensuring resolution of risk and issues, escalating, as necessary. Provides rigorous management and analysis of overall portfolio budget (including spend and forecasted spend vs. budget, spend per program and historical trends, etc.). Establishes scalable frameworks (process, tools, etc.) for the end\-to\-end project and manages stakeholders applying project management standards and documentation best practices. Runs standups and sprint planning exercises for programs owned. Builds and maintains consistent reporting across numerous programs. Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel. Performs other duties as assigned.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC4
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Requirements Gathering \& Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders and process owners to thoroughly understand their requirements, document functional specifications, and translate these into system configurations.
* System Integration: Facilitate seamless integration of O2C processes within the CFIN system, as well as with other enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, etc.), ensuring smooth data flow and automation of processes across platforms. User Support \& Training: Provide ongoing functional support to end\-users, addressing issues, offering solutions, and conducting training to ensure optimal utilization of the system and full understanding of O2C processes.
* Testing \& Validation: Participate in testing and validation activities for new configurations, enhancements, and fixes, ensuring they meet business and functional requirements. Process Optimization: Regularly monitor and evaluate O2C processes to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency improvements, and best practice implementation within the CFIN system.
* Documentation \& Compliance: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for O2C system configurations, process flows, and integration points, ensuring compliance with internal standards and regulatory guidelines. Collaboration with Technical Teams: Work closely with IS architects, developers, and technical teams to ensure that functional requirements are correctly implemented and aligned with system design specifications.
* Troubleshooting \& Issue Resolution: Provide expert troubleshooting support for O2C\-related system issues, working collaboratively with cross\-functional teams to resolve any challenges promptly. Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about the latest industry trends, best practices, and system updates to continuously enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of O2C processes within CFIN.
* Project and New Demand Management: Take ownership of configuring new demands or changes in system functionality, ensuring proper alignment with system design documentation and business requirements. O2C\-Related Data Management: Oversee the management and accuracy of O2C\-related data within the system, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and compliance with business rules across all O2C processes.


**Qualifications for the role:**
* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications in O2C SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN, or IT architecture. Proven experience (5\+ years) in O2C process management, with a strong background in system configuration and implementation within SAP or similar ERP environments (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN).
* Strong functional knowledge of Order\-to\-Cash processes, including order management, credit management, billing, collections, and accounts receivable. Experience in configuring O2C processes in SAP or similar ERP systems, with a solid understanding of integration points and data flows across systems. Familiarity with Central Finance (CFIN) and integration with other finance\-related modules.
* Experience with requirements gathering, business analysis, and documentation of functional specifications. High level understanding on Credit Management \& Integration process between source \& CFIN High level Down Payment concepts, Industry solution for Project Cash flow, Provisioning based on global rule sets, Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, stakeholders, and technical teams. A strong focus on continuous improvement and automation, with a passion for driving innovation within enterprise systems. Experience in managing relationships with external vendors and third\-party service providers to ensure the delivery of high\-quality solutions. Ability to adapt to a fast\-paced, dynamic work environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.


**More about us:**
 ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world\-class team who delivers forward\-looking insights that drive sustainable long\-term results and operates with the highest standards.
   

  

 We value people from different backgrounds. Apply today for your next career step within ABB and visit www.abb.com to learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. \#MyABBStory
   

  

 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

8a48b341.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Director Product Architect (Java, REST, SpringBoot, AI/ML, LLM)
Overview:  

  

Who is Mastercard?  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to power an inclusive digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making payment transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

  

  

Overview  

Mastercard’s 'Network Products' team is a group of thought leaders with an uncanny bias for action and an unrelenting focus on growth. The 'Product Architecture' unit(within 'Network Products'), owns the product's architectural vision and has responsiblity to deliver product architectural solutions, that drive growth story of our 'Switching' and 'Network Services' capabilities.  

Product Architects work closely with Product Managers, Regional Solutions to understand business goals and functional requirements, and put up high level System Design(aka Architectural Blueprint). This is an "Individual Contributor" role demanding strong technical, design, communication and negotiation skills.  

  

  

Role  

As a Product Architect – Network Products, you will be responsible for shaping the end‑to‑end product architecture of Mastercard’s switching and network services. You will work across the full product lifecycle—from ideation and discovery through execution and retrospection—to ensure that product architectures remain aligned with evolving business needs and technology landscapes.This is an "Individual Contributor" role. You will play a critical role in defining architectural direction, validating technical feasibility of ideas, driving innovation, and ensuring that product designs support scalability, resilience, performance, and security at network scale.  

  

* Collaborate with Product Managers, Business stakeholders, and Regional Solution teams to define and refine the product vision, goals, and success criteria.
* Should bring a strong understanding of AI\-enabled product development and be able to identify practical opportunities to apply AI across platform architecture, product strategy, operational efficiency, and customer experience. Hands on expert
* Provide early architectural assessments of product ideas, evaluating Technical feasibility, Architectural fit and Long‑term scalability and operability
* Establish and advocate the Architecture Principles supporting Decoupling, Scale, Distributed processing, Microservices, Domain Driven Design, Performance, Security, Event Driven Architecture etc.
* Define the high level Logical Architecture(aka System Design) of the product, aligning to architecture principles. Ability to build consensus on the architectural solutions.
* For for new Product offerings, Epics \& Use\-cases, produce System Design documentation \& Architecture artifacts, covering domain principles, service interactions, trade\-offs and flow level architecture etc.
* Engage deeply with dependent and adjacent domains to ensure seamless integration while preserving clear domain boundaries and ownership.
* Work closely with Engineering teams, Service Architects, and Development Managers to ensure implementation adheres to approved product architecture principles and designs.
* Ideate, analyze and architect enhancements to our Network that will delight our customers.
* Support customer‑level, market‑level, and regional engagements by providing architectural insight to address strategic opportunities, risks, and technical challenges.
* Ability to Clearly articulate architectural trade‑offs and design rationale to diverse audiences, including business, technology, and leadership stakeholders.

  

  

Skillset  

* Strong hands‑on knowledge and experience in software architecture and system design for complex, enterprise‑scale systems.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and AI\-assisted workflows. Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, knowledge graphs, or enterprise knowledge retrieval patterns.
* Experience building, integrating, or experimenting with LLMs, AI automation solutions, prompt engineering, AI\-assisted development tools, or machine learning use cases will be a strong advantage
* Strong technical knowledge and demonstrated experience in Software Architecture and System Design.
* Proven history of designing enterprise\-grade applications following Domain Driven Design, Microservices, Event Driven Systems, Cloud Native principles, API design, Eventual Consistency etc.
* Exposure to Cloud, Messaging middlewares, Monitoring tools, Authentication/Authorization, gRPC, REST, Variety of Persistence and Caching technologies, Frontend stack, AI/ML, LLM, Deep learning etc.


\- Exposure to following technologies\- Java, REST, SpringBoot, Kafka, NATS, gRPC, noSQL, Cassandra, AI/ML, LLM, Postgres, Redis, Prometheus, Grafana, React etc.  

* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Strong ability to distill complex systems into clear, structured documentation
* Exhibit sound judgment and swift decision\-making skills, strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Understanding of payments industry, payment services and \*Switching\* is a plus.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

IND Senior Staff Software Engineer \- GCC020

 You are a driven and motivated problem solver ready to pursue meaningful work with strong technical, design and architectural skills. You strive to make an impact every day \- not only at work, but in your personal life and community too. If that sounds like you, then you've landed in the right place.
   

  

 The Hartford is seeking a transformative, customer\-centric Solution Architect to join the Claims and Operations IT team supporting
 **core financial, billing, and operational platforms** 
 as we progress through our modernization agenda. This role will focus on
 **scalable platform architecture, financial workflows, and experience\-driven capabilities** 
 , delivering value across lines of business. If you’re a passionate technical leader with a continuous learning mindset and motivation to stay on top of the latest trends in emerging technologies such as
 **AI/GenAI, cloud platforms (AWS), APIs, event\-driven architectures, microservices/micro frontends, SaaS solutions, and platform engineering** 
 , then this position is for you.
   

  

 This is a technical leadership position that allows you to apply your strong application design, development, and excellent communication skills. This position will be responsible for conceptualizing and designing innovative end\-to\-end software architectures that enable strategic business objectives across
 **transactional financial systems, operational workflows, and digital servicing platforms** 
 . You will create end\-to\-end
 **AI\-enabled and digital\-first solution designs** 
 , including intelligent automation, document processing, and decisioning, spanning across multiple components and technologies in a dynamic, Agile environment. You will also provide technical leadership to project teams as the solution design progresses through implementation into run.
   

  

 Additionally, you will have the opportunity to influence business leaders and shape the business vision by aligning technology strategies with business goals, ensuring that our
 **cloud\- and AI\-first approach** 
 drives impactful outcomes across modernization initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Leverage AI and Generative AI capabilities to accelerate solution design and engineering productivity, including rapid prototyping, architecture pattern generation, intelligent code assistance, and synthesis of technical insights. Apply these capabilities to enhance product analysis, improve decision\-making, and drive faster, higher\-quality delivery outcomes.
* Drive hands\-on development of proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) and reference implementations, generating functional code aligned to defined requirements to validate architecture patterns, de\-risk solutions, and provide delivery teams with a clear and practical runway to accelerate execution and scale adoption.
* Establish and drive clear, effective, and innovative solution designs aligning to The Hartford’s reference architectures, blueprints, and business and IT strategies across core platforms and financial/operational ecosystems, with a focus on AI and strategic thinking.
* Develop architectural standards and designs for customer\-facing and internal servicing capabilities, including digital experiences and operational workflows, incorporating a visionary approach and end\-to\-end solutioning with a big picture mindset.
* Align solutions to The Hartford’s reference architectures, blueprints, and business and IT strategies, ensuring they are plug\-and\-play and leverage APIs, event\-driven integrations, reusable services, and platform\-based architectures.
* Ensure alignment with security standards, authentication, authorization, and enterprise compliance requirements, while integrating vendor platforms, SaaS solutions, and AI/ML services into the ecosystem.
* Provide design supporting the migration of platforms and applications to the cloud, including modernization of legacy systems into cloud\-native, containerized, and event\-driven architectures, taking advantage of rationalization opportunities to reduce costs and promote a frugal architecture mindset.
* Design solutions leveraging SaaS and Native Cloud architectures and services, including AI services, data platforms, and integration layers, focusing on scalable and reusable architecture patterns.
* Develop designs and integrations spanning both Mobile and Responsive Web, ensuring digital capabilities are accessible across customer, agent, and internal roles.
* Participate with agile teams to ensure architecture standards are being maintained, promoting a platform, product, and API\-first engineering model.
* Frequently interact with peers and senior leaders as part of a cross\-functional team, influencing business leaders and shaping business vision.
* Work within a matrixed environment, expanding knowledge of The Hartford’s lines of business and end\-to\-end operational and financial workflows.
* Emphasize cost\-conscious architecture and frugal architecture principles, ensuring that solutions are designed to be cost\-effective and efficient, particularly across high\-volume transactional and event\-driven workloads.
* Foster a mindset of building platforms and products that prioritize speed to market and lower maintenance costs, leveraging cloud\-native services, reusable platforms, and AI capabilities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree with 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in designing and implementing robust enterprise\-level digital and platform solutions with a broad understanding of traditional and modern software technology frameworks, platforms, vendor software solutions, development tools, and processes.
* Cloud certifications and architecture certifications are a plus.
* Experience developing or designing single\-page applications utilizing contemporary frameworks such as Angular/React, supporting modern digital and operational interfaces.
* Experience designing and implementing cloud\-based solutions utilizing Microservices or API\-based integrations with a clear understanding of JSON, REST, and HTTP standards, including event streaming and asynchronous messaging patterns.
* Clear understanding of cloud, hybrid cloud, and container deployment architectures including building cloud\-ready applications and container orchestration systems supporting scalable, distributed applications.
* Experience of working with agile development teams delivering platform and product\-based solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and technical writing skills with the ability to effectively communicate solution recommendations and influence key stakeholders.
* Experience with multi\-cloud environments and AI technologies, demonstrating the ability to design and implement solutions that leverage these technologies to drive business value and innovation, including GenAI use cases, intelligent automation, and data\-driven decisioning.
* Experience with Micro Frontends (MFEs), demonstrating the ability to design and implement modular and scalable front\-end architectures.

In addition, we are looking for someone who has a blend of program/project management experience added with experience in tech acumen to scale our tech service offerings.

* Lead the planning, execution and delivery of business\-critical/high impacting projects on the team's roadmap and ensure they are delivered with high quality and within budget.
* Work with leadership team to drive critical business initiatives across the organization
* Develop, implement and govern KPIs reporting for the portfolio providing visibility to the milestones and performance across all projects
* Drive and influence stakeholders across product, engineering, business and Ops teams on improvement opportunities

* Communicate across all levels on project and program progress
* Coach, mentor and guide new team members
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Hands on experience at program managing an AI solution

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. 1c3c694e.title: Senior Cloud AI Engineer - Ai Platform
1c3c694e.description:
**Our Company**


At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.


**What You'll Do**


At Teradata, we're not just managing data; we're unleashing its full potential. Our Teradata AI Studio platform and pioneering Enterprise Vector Store are empowering the world's largest enterprises to derive unprecedented value from their most complex data. We're rapidly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with Artificial Intelligence, especially in the exciting realm of **autonomous and agentic systems**


We’re building intelligent systems that go far beyond automation — they observe, reason, adapt, and drive complex decision\-making across large\-scale enterprise environments. As a member of our AI engineering team, you’ll play a critical role in designing and deploying advanced AI agents that integrate deeply with business operations, turning data into insight, action, and measurable outcomes.


In this role, you’ll architect foundational components for production\-grade AI systems — from agent frameworks and LLM pipelines to observability and evaluation layers that ensure reliability, accountability, and performance. You’ll be responsible not just for building models, but for making them measurable, debuggable, and trustworthy in real\-world, high\-stakes deployments.


You’ll work alongside a high\-caliber team of AI researchers, engineers, and data scientists tackling some of the hardest problems in AI and enterprise software — from scalable multi\-agent coordination and fine\-tuned LLM applications, to real\-time monitoring, drift detection, and closed\-loop retraining systems.


If you're passionate about building intelligent systems that are not only powerful but observable, resilient, and production\-ready, this role offers the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise AI from the ground up.


**Key Responsibilities:**
* Design and deploy containerized applications using Docker and container orchestration platforms. Understand platform engineering.
* Implement and manage Kubernetes clusters for AI/ML workloads, ensuring high availability and scalability.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Terraform for infrastructure as code and automated deployments.
* Collaborate on MLOps practices including model versioning, deployment, and monitoring.
* Manage and optimize LLM deployments, including inference endpoints and API gateways.
* Design infrastructure to support AI agent orchestration, prompt routing, and multi\-agent collaboration.
* Implement Kubernetes\-native AI microservices to support scalable inference and agent collaboration workloads.
* Spearhead the deployment, versioning, and monitoring of ML/LLM models using CI/CD pipelines and MLOps tools.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code principles.
* Implement monitoring, logging, and observability solutions for containerized AI/ML applications.
* Work with LLM APIs and frameworks to support AI\-driven features and integrations.
* Collaborate with data science and ML teams to operationalize models into production.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD workflows for continuous integration and deployment of ML models.
* Ensure system reliability, security, and performance at scale.
* Contribute to internal standards and best practices for cloud\-native AI system development.
* Support containerized application deployments across development, staging, and production environments.
**Who You'll Work With**


Imagine collaborating daily with some of the brightest minds in the company – individuals who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You'll be part of a cohesive force, laser\-focused on delivering high\-quality, critical, and highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Cloud platform. Your insights will directly shape the future of our intelligent data solutions.


You'll report directly to the inspiring Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions.


**What Makes You A Qualified Candidate**


* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field – your academic foundation is key.
* 2\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud\-native architectures.
* \*\*MUST HAVE\*\*: Strong hands\-on experience with containerization technologies (Docker, containerd).
* \*\*BIG BONUS\*\*: Experience with Kubernetes (K8s) cluster management and orchestration.
* Solid understanding of MLOps principles and practices for ML model lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of large language models (LLMs) and experience managing LLM deployments.
* Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Terraform for infrastructure automation.
* Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash, or similar) for automation.
* Understanding of networking, security, and infrastructure best practices.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).
* Experience with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows.

**What You'll Bring**


* Experience with Kubernetes ecosystem tools (Helm, Operators, Service Mesh like Istio).
* Knowledge of AI/ML frameworks and model serving platforms (TensorFlow Serving, KServe, MLflow).
* Experience with LLM\-specific tools and frameworks (LangChain, vector databases, prompt engineering).
* Familiarity with GitOps practices and tools (ArgoCD, Flux).
* Experience with infrastructure security and compliance standards.
* Contributions to open\-source projects or technical communities.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work in a collaborative team environment.
* Ownership mindset with a focus on reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement.

6df25c86.description:
**About Neo4j**
 Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise\-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy\-to\-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
   

  

 Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
   

  

 As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Help AI\-focused startups in Neo4j’s Startup Program succeed with graph \+ LLM solutions so they adopt Neo4j deeply and grow into long\-term, high\-value customers.
   

  

 This is a highly technical, customer\-facing role focused on helping AI startups onboard successfully, design effective solutions, and scale their Neo4j use over time. The role blends solution architecture, technical advisory, and ongoing customer engagement to support startups from early experimentation through production adoption.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership for Startup Customers**
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of AI startups in the program.
* Guide teams in designing, building, and deploying Neo4j\-based architectures.
* Advise on best practices for Neo4j usage across Aura and self\-managed environments, including scaling, performance, and production readiness.
* Troubleshoot implementation challenges and help customers make sound technical tradeoffs.


**Graph \+ AI / LLM Solution Design**
* Help startups design and implement LLM\-enabled solutions using Neo4j, including RAG, knowledge graphs, and agent\-based architectures.
* Translate customer AI requirements into concrete Neo4j\-centered architectures, patterns, and implementation guidance.
* Work with common AI frameworks and tooling such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, PydanticAI or ADK, agent frameworks, vector search, and open\-source and commercial LLMs.
* Identify and promote repeatable graph \+ AI solution patterns across the startup portfolio.


**Customer Success and Technical Relationship Ownership**
* Own the ongoing technical relationship with assigned startups.
* Run regular check\-ins, track progress, and proactively identify risks or blockers.
* Help customers move from early experimentation to successful production adoption.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner closely with the Field AI team to align on architectures, patterns, and technical strategy.
* Feed real\-world startup requirements, usage patterns, and product gaps back to Product and Field teams.
* Bridge product gaps where needed through third\-party tools, integrations, and pragmatic solution design.


**Enablement and Knowledge Sharing**
* Contribute to internal enablement content, examples, office hours, and best practices for graph \+ AI patterns.
* Share lessons learned from startup engagements with broader Field teams.
* Help standardize playbooks, templates, and reference implementations for the Startup Program.

**Job Title:**


Principal, IT Architecture**Job Description:**

**SAP GTS Solution Architec****t**

**Job Summary**  

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled SAP GTS Solution Architect to join our team. In this role, you will be a key driver in defining, designing, and delivering our SAP GTS strategy, which includes leading our upcoming upgrade from SAP GTS to E4HANA (Edition for HANA). This is a comprehensive position combining high\-level architectural oversight, hands\-on design, and ongoing production support. The ideal candidate will have at least 10 years of SAP experience, a deep specialization in SAP GTS, and a proven track record of supporting and designing global trade solutions.

 **Responsibilities**


Architect and Design:

* Serve as the primary architect for all SAP GTS initiatives, from initial design through to successful deployment in the new E4HANA landscape.
* Translate complex business requirements into clear, efficient, and scalable SAP GTS solutions.
* Lead and conduct requirements\-gathering workshops with global trade, logistics, and IT stakeholders.
* Document detailed functional and technical specifications for all GTS configurations, enhancements, and integrations.

E4H Migration:

* Lead the Entegris architectural planning, design, and execution of the SAP GTS upgrade to E4H alongside the integration partner.
* Conduct system assessments and fit\-gap analysis to identify business needs, recommend best practices, and define the optimal GTS solution roadmap for the new environment.
* Oversee data migration, interface compatibility, and integration of GTS with SAP ECC modules (e.g., SD, MM, FI), as well as third\-party systems.

Production Support \& Optimization:

* Provide expert\-level, day\-to\-day functional and technical support for the SAP GTS system and related processes.
* Act as a point of escalation for complex GTS incidents and problems, leading troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Monitor system performance and proactively recommend improvements and optimization strategies for trade compliance and customs processes.
* Provide hyper\-care and sustainment support during project go\-lives and for production issues.

Compliance and Governance:

* Act as the subject matter expert for all GTS modules, including Compliance Management (SPL, Legal Control, Embargo), Customs Management (Export/Import), and Risk Management.
* Stay informed about changes in international trade regulations and trade compliance laws to ensure the company’s ongoing compliance.
* Drive solution governance and ensure that all new developments and changes adhere to design standards and best practices.
**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 10\+ years of overall SAP experience, with at least 5 years focused specifically on SAP GTS.
* **GTS Expertise:** Extensive experience in designing, configuring, and supporting SAP GTS solutions, covering Compliance Management, Customs Management, and Risk Management.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Proven experience with SAP ECC\-GTS and S/4HANA\-GTS integration, including familiarity with BADI enhancements, document transfer, and mapping.
* **Upgrade Experience:** Hands\-on experience with at least one full\-cycle SAP GTS implementation or upgrade to Edition for HANA (e4H) and integration with S/4HANA.
* **Analytical Skills:** Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions.
* **Communication:** Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical teams, business executives, and cross\-cultural stakeholders effectively.
* **Certifications:** SAP GTS or S/4HANA certifications are highly desirable.

**Company Description** 
 Fuzia \| Fuzia Talent is an AI\-enabled growth support partner for founders, coaches, consultants, and small businesses seeking scalable, sustainable growth without burnout. Evolving from a globally recognized women\-led community into a systems\-focused execution partner, Fuzia combines expert women talent, AI\-powered workflows, and outcome\-driven processes to build repeatable growth engines. The organization has supported over 1,500 businesses worldwide, delivered more than 10,000 projects, and nurtures a community of 6M\+ people, with recognition from the Women Economic Forum and Forbes and backing from Opengrowth Ventures. Fuzia’s flexible engagement model ranges from one\-time projects to dedicated, recurring teams, tailored to clients’ specific goals across marketing, lead generation, operations, and launches. At its core, Fuzia is on a mission to economically empower women through meaningful remote work while helping clients reduce operational load, scale faster, and grow with purpose.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Presales Manager will play a key role in shaping solutions for founders, coaches, and growing businesses by translating their needs into actionable proposals and system\-led execution plans. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include engaging with inbound and outbound leads, conducting discovery calls, analyzing client requirements, and designing tailored presales solutions that align with Fuzia’s AI\-enabled workflows and talent capabilities. The role will involve preparing presentations and demos, collaborating with sales, consulting, and delivery teams to refine offerings, and supporting the development of pricing, proposals, and integration plans. The Presales Manager will also track pipeline performance, provide feedback to improve service offerings, and contribute to repeatable sales processes that support scalable growth. This is a full\-time remote role.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Presales and Sales skills, including experience in solution design, proposal development, and handling complex client requirements.
* Candidates should possess solid Consulting and client advisory skills to conduct discovery, understand business challenges, and recommend system\-led growth solutions.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills to coordinate cross\-functional teams, manage timelines, and ensure smooth transition from presales to delivery.
* Candidates should possess Integration\-related skills, with the ability to understand and articulate how tools, workflows, and services connect within client ecosystems.
* Relevant qualifications include experience in B2B services or SaaS, familiarity with AI\-enabled or tech\-enabled business solutions, and working with founders or small businesses.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to work independently in a remote, fast\-paced environment are essential.
* A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field is preferred, along with prior presales or solution consulting experience.

c90228db.title: Solution Architect (Client Solution & Integration Architecture)
c90228db.description:
Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 160 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry\-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.
   

  

 We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.
   

  

**Job Description**
 You will work in the Client Solution and Integration Architecture team, within the Product \& Technology Organization. The mission of the department is to design and manage the End to End Architecture of the Solutions for Banks worldwide, which will adopt an Avaloq based outsourcing services portfolio. The team is composed of senior Business / IT / Enterprise Architects with a strong focus on customer facing activities, including consulting, solutions definition and documentation.
   

  

**Your key tasks**
* Work as Solution Manager with the objective of defining the most effective solutions for banks in terms of architectural patterns, functional modules, 3rd party products integration, standards, investments, process and technology, to support the enterprise business strategy, ensuring that architectures excellence and banks needs are balanced
* Be responsible and accountable to write the Solution definition documents for the running change or transformation projects for the Avaloq Clients. Document client architectures using Enterprise Architecture tools. Support cost estimations and offering activities
* Collect, analyze and maintain client requirements and translate them into Information system or service solutions. Drive solutions selection according to the following criteria: cost efficiency, competitiveness of offering, improve STP and Back Office efficiency, adherence with company strategic objectives, reduced complexity
* Assist Avaloq clients with consulting mandates on Solution Architecture topics
* Bring a High\-Level perspective into the functional or system analysis, during feasibility studies, solution definitions and projects
* Support project managers in planning the solution aspects of large transformation programs, including cost estimations
* Support Avaloq management in strategic decisions and promote the latest architectural principles throughout the organization


**Qualifications**
* Long running experience and proven track record in Avaloq implementation projects including integration of 3rd party systems. Up to date knowledge on business and IT architectures patterns, methods, and tooling
* Long running experience in one or more of the following architecture roles: Business/Banking Architectures, Technology/Software/Integration Architectures, Enterprise Architectures, Digital Banking
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, including teamwork, facilitation, and negotiation
* Consulting attitude and experience, to be authoritative and convincing in business discussion with clients
* Fluency in English


**It would be a real bonus if you have**
* Fluency on the following languages: Tagalog, Mandarin, German, French or Italian is an advantage
* Formal certification on the following areas and similar: Avaloq, TOGAF, ITIL, Open Group, Cloud, Openshift/REST APIs, Digital and Mobile, Bank Industry certifications


**Additional Information**
 We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
   

  

 In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
   

  

 We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
   

  

 Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.
